title: Sr. Full Stack Engineer
description:
Who We Are:

PureSpectrum is a rapidly growing market research and insights platform that simplifies technology, allowing researchers to gather and activate consumer data without disruption. As the go-to solution for high-quality multi-sourcing and fully automated research, PureSpectrum is helping to shape the future of insights.


Our Marketplace facilitates over 65 million online interviews annually, and our proprietary respondent-level scoring system, PureScore, continues to set the industry standard for data quality and reliability.


Recognized globally for both innovation and culture, PureSpectrum has been named one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces (2023–2025), included in Inc.’s Best Workplaces ), certified as a Great Place to Work (2022–2025), and featured on Built In’s Best Places to Work list (2023–2025). PS is rapidly becoming the leading solution for quality multi-sourcing and end-to-end automated research solution.


The Opportunity:

PureSpectrum is seeking a highly skilled Sr. Engineer to join our high-impact Product & Engineering team. This is a full-stack role with a primary emphasis on backend engineering. You will be responsible for architecting, developing, and maintaining the core services, scalable RESTful APIs, and cloud infrastructure that power our mobile application. In addition to infrastructure and API design, you will optimize database interactions to ensure high performance. This is a fast-paced role within our global organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Manager.


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Your Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop scalable, robust RESTful API endpoints using .NET Core to support high-volume data consumption.
  • Design and optimize database structures using MySQL and write optimized queries for better performance and data integrity.
  • Implement and maintain server-side logic, integrating with third-party services using C# and object-oriented design principles.
  • Deploy and maintain scalable cloud solutions on AWS, specifically utilizing EC2/Beanstalk, RDS, SQS, SES, SNS, S3, and Lambda.
  • Test drive development and write comprehensive Unit/Integration tests to ensure code quality and stability.
  • Follow best practices in version control (Git), CI/CD, and cloud deployments to ensure efficient release cycles.
  • Implement new features in our mobile app using Flutter.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a similar discipline from any recognized University.
  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience building back-end applications using .NET Core and ORMs like Entity Framework.
  • Strong proficiency in C# and deep understanding of MVC design patterns.
  • AWS Cloud Expertise: Proven experience designing, deploying, and maintaining scalable and reliable cloud solutions leveraging core AWS services, including EC2/Beanstalk, RDS, SQS, SES, SNS, S3, and Lambda.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases with a preference for MySQL, including schema design and query optimization.
  • Knowledge of JSON, HTML, YAML, REST standards, and Git version control.
  • Knowledge of build pipelines (e.g., AWS CodePipeline, Bitbucket, GitLab).
  • Knowledge of Linux and command line interface operations.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Basic knowledge of Flutter and/or native mobile development (iOS/Android), including the MVVM design pattern


Nice to Have

  • Experience with mobile development technologies, specifically Flutter/Dart.
  • Experience with Firebase.
  • Knowledge of Shell script, JavaScript, and Native mobile development for Android/iOS.
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Comfort with fast-moving teams and working across time zones with distributed teams.


PureSpectrum Perks:

Join PureSpectrum and become part of our innovative culture (PSX), where we prioritize your professional growth and foster a strong sense of team connection. You'll be part of a rewarding, high-standard environment where team members genuinely enjoy regular celebrations and events—a truly exceptional experience at every level.





PureSpectrum is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited under the law.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior (Node.js/TypeScript)
description:
Quem somos?


Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto - SP, com a missão de tornar as organizações da saúde mais eficientes, possibilitando a melhor assistência aos pacientes. Queremos ser reconhecidos como uma das maiores provedoras de serviços de informações a operadores de saúde!


No nosso ambiente de trabalho, procuramos sempre agir com base nos nossos valores. É através deles que chegaremos mais perto de alcançar nossos objetivos:

  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Pense grande;
  • Excelente não é suficiente;
  • Fail fast, learn faster;
  • Inovar para revolucionar;
  • Simples sempre;
  • Só é bom pra gente se for bom pro cliente;


Qual o desafio?


Buscamos uma pessoa com visão arquitetural e experiência em alta escalabilidade para elevar o nível técnico do nosso time. Você terá papel fundamental na definição de padrões de engenharia e na construção de sistemas robustos que impactam diretamente a eficiência do setor de saúde.


O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia?


Sua missão vai além de escrever código: você será uma referência técnica dentro da Carefy.


  • Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;
  • Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;
  • Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (NestJS/Next.js);
  • Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;
  • Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;
  • Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.


Qual o contexto?


Você fará parte do nosso time de integração. Somos os responsáveis pela interoperabilidade da Carefy. Nossa missão é conectar nossa plataforma aos ecossistemas heterogêneos das operadoras de saúde, garantindo que os dados fluam com segurança e performance. Neste time, você atuará como referência técnica : participando diretamente do desenho de soluções junto aos times de TI dos clientes e, internamente, traduzindo esses desafios complexos em uma arquitetura limpa e em demandas organizadas para orientar o desenvolvimento.


O que esperamos de você?


  • Visão Sistêmica: Capacidade de enxergar o impacto de uma decisão técnica em todo o ecossistema do produto.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Habilidade de negociar soluções técnicas com clientes externos e guiar o time interno com clareza.
  • Autonomia com Responsabilidade: Habilidade para tocar projetos complexos com pouca supervisão, gerenciando riscos.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Foco na causa raiz e em soluções definitivas.


Quais são os requisitos?


  • Mínimo de 6 anos de experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência de 4+ anos com Node.js e TypeScript em produção;
  • Experiência de 4+ anos Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL) , incluindo modelagem e otimização;
  • Experiência comprovada com Arquitetura de Software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD);
  • Experiência prática com Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e serviços de Mensageria (RabbitMQ/Kafka) ;
  • Experiência na criação e manutenção de APIs RESTful escaláveis;
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta criticidade e volume de dados;
  • Domínio de frameworks modernos como NestJS e/ou Next.js ;
  • Conhecimento prático em testes automatizados (TDD , testes unitários e de integração);
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa.


Será um diferencial:


  • Experiência com PHP: Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;
  • Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
  • Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).


O que oferecemos?


  • Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido (para residentes em Ribeirão Preto e região) ou 100% Remoto (para candidatos de outras localidades);
  • Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;
  • Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VA e VR);
  • Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;
  • Horários flexíveis;
  • Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!


Faça parte da nossa revolução na saúde!

title: Content Specialist
description:
Our purpose


ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.


Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.


Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all.

Who we are


We’re a real tech success story, built from the ground up with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.


Through our years, we’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from the ground up... with our own team.


Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.



The Opportunity


The Content Specialist is an exciting role in ecoPortal’s marketing team, directly contributing to our content strategy. You’ll be part of a team with big aspirations, changing perceptions of health and safety worldwide.



Ideal for someone who has:


  • A Bachelors (or higher) Degree in marketing/ journalism/ communications or similar major.
  • Exceptional written and verbal English fluency.
  • A strong understanding of SEO and CRO copywriting.
  • A flair for story-telling, with the ability to demonstrate technical writing.
  • A passion for writing with an excellent eye for detail, grammar, brand tone and style.
  • Experience in marketing in a tech and/or SaaS company is an advantage.
  • An understanding of the buyer journey and how best to capture people's interest at each stage.
  • Experience in managing Podcasts, Webinars and live content events.
  • The ability to meet deadlines, be a self-starter and have a can-do attitude.
  • Great communication skills, with the ability to liaise with both internal and external stakeholders regularly.


Key Responsibilities


  • Execution of the company’s content strategy, with the aim of educating, engaging, entertaining and empowering people across the company’s full customer lifecycle.
  • Be a driving force behind the execution of a broad range of top-notch content including ad campaigns, web copy, email marketing, blogs, case studies, webinars, event collateral, videos and more.
  • Planning webinar and podcast series and managing all production aspects, from prospecting and inviting potential speakers to writing briefings and scripts and supporting the recording or live delivery.
  • Creation of compelling monthly and quarterly newsletters, with ongoing performance tracking and a focus on finding new ways to improve engagement.
  • Keep your finger on the pulse of what’s front of mind for professionals in the world of health and safety and use that to input on content and campaign idea generation.
  • Support the Sales and Success teams by creating targeted collateral, emails, social posts and case studies to drive conversions and upsell opportunities;
  • Support the company’s SEO initiatives, scope and create content that helps the company get found via organic traffic;
  • Contribute to ecoPortal’s content strategy and execution.
  • Take a campaign approach to content development. Implement SEO best practices, test, and iterate your content and creative processes with the aim of increasing ecoPortal’s reach, generating demand, and converting prospects to customers.
  • Support other team-wide initiatives with targeted collateral (i.e. web, email) that leverages strong storytelling to get key ecoPortal messages across in inspiring and unique ways;
  • Keep your work in Trello and the content calendar up-to-date and set up other administrative processes as required;
  • Closely monitor new content trends, and proactively seek creative opportunities where these can be best utilised at the company.
  • Own and manage our content partnership relationships, agreements and event partner content.
  • Collaborate with other Creative Team members, including Graphic Designers, Video Specialists, as well as members of the Digital Marketing Team.
  • Contribute to brand and content reporting as required.
  • Support the Content Marketing Manager and wider marketing team in other areas of the business that align with your skillset as required.



Perks & Benefits:


We hope that you're excited by the possibilities that come with working at ecoPortal! In addition to our welcoming and diverse culture, we also offer these fun perks and benefits.


37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.


End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️


Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training.


❤️

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Analyst to provide functional production support for enterprise Contract Management Software (CMS/CLM) platforms. This role focuses on incident resolution, configuration support, and close collaboration with business users and technical teams to ensure system stability and efficient contract operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 production support for Contract Management Software platforms, including incident, problem, and service request management.
  • Analyze and resolve issues related to:
  • Contract templates, clause libraries, and fallback logic
  • Workflows, approvals, and business rule configurations
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract type setups
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring functional and configuration-related issues.
  • Support minor enhancements and functional configuration changes (non-code).
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues and coordinate with Level 3 technical teams when required.
  • Manage user access, role assignments, and permission-related issues.
  • Execute approved data corrections, metadata updates, and configuration fixes.
  • Support UAT and regression testing for fixes and minor platform updates.
  • Maintain support documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate closely with L1 support teams, business stakeholders, and L3 technical teams to ensure timely issue resolution.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience providing production support for Contract Management Software (CLM/CMS) platforms (e.g., Icertis, Coupa CLM, DocuSign CLM, SAP CLM, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with functional configurations, including:
  • Contract templates and clause libraries
  • Workflows, rules, and approvals
  • English (B2- Fluent)
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract types
  • Solid understanding of contract lifecycle management processes .
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications in complex or regulated environments.
  • Exposure to system integrations with ERP, CRM, or document management platforms.
  • Familiarity with ITIL-based support models or Agile delivery environments.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Professional Services Technician
description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro


Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar como especialista em Serviços Profissionais na Lynx Financial Crime Tech, com uma posição baseada no Brasil, em modelo remoto, em colaboração com o time global de Serviços Profissionais em Madrid (Espanha) e com foco em clientes no Brasil e em outros países da América Latina.


A Lynx Financial Crime Tech S.A, é uma empresa de software baseado em IA, especializada em detectar e prever padrões de comportamento. Liderados por uma equipe experiente do setor financeiro e acadêmico, desenvolvemos e implementamos tecnologias de IA de ponta e autoaprendizado. Nossa plataforma se destaca em tecnologias de processamento de transações de baixa latência e está disponível tanto on-premise quanto em nuvem.

Priorizamos VISÃO, AGILIDADE e VELOCIDADE para oferecer experiências excepcionais aos clientes e construímos relacionamentos duradouros e de confiança com algumas das principais instituições financeiras, fintechs e empresas comerciais em todo o mundo.

Adotamos uma forte cultura de risco e esperamos que toda a nossa equipe, independentemente do cargo que ocupem, tenha uma atitude proativa e responsável em relação à gestão de riscos. A Lynx se orgulha de ser uma organização com igualdade de oportunidades, independentemente de identidade de gênero, cultura ou deficiência. Nossa missão é contribuir para que mais pessoas e empresas prosperem.


O que você vai fazer

Como Professional Services Technician, seu objetivo será garantir um serviço excelente para nossos clientes sediados no Brasil (e em outras regiões da América Latina), participando ativamente das diferentes etapas do ciclo de vida: onboarding, implantação, acompanhamento e novas necessidades.

Precisamos de alguém como você para nos ajudar em diferentes frentes:

· Liderar e gerir projetos de implementação das nossas soluções.

· Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes: identificar novas necessidades, resolver dúvidas e oferecer orientação sobre o uso correto das nossas soluções.

· Fornecer consultoria especializada e executar os serviços profissionais das nossas soluções de Detecção e Prevenção de Crime Financeiro e Lavagem de Dinheiro.

· Dar suporte técnico aos nossos times internos de Vendas nas fases iniciais de contato com clientes: demos, reuniões técnicas etc.

· Atuar como elo entre nossos clientes e as equipes de Desenvolvimento e Suporte.


✅ O que buscamos em você

Experiência em gestão de projetos de tecnologia;

Ensino superior completo;

Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras ou empresas relacionadas ao setor;

Experiência em departamentos de Serviços Profissionais em outras empresas do setor;

Idiomas: domínio avançado de inglês (mandatório).


✅ O que pode contar pontos a mais

Conhecimentos de Linux – nível usuário.

Espanhol avançado;

Conhecimento em Fraude e/ou Lavagem de Dinheiro;

Capacidade para trabalhar em equipe;

Boas habilidades de comunicação;

Capacidade de se adaptar a ambientes em constante mudança.


Seguinte passo

Candidate-se e se você conhece alguém que possa estar procurando por essa oportunidade, compartilhe.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager – NAMER
description:

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead and scale recruitment operations for NAMER (North America) clients within an AI/R company structure. This role is responsible for building high-performing talent acquisition strategies to support growth in cutting-edge areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and advanced software engineering.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills;
  • Experience working in fast-paced, scaling, or consulting environments.
  • Advanced English
  • Strong data-driven mindset

title: Tech Lead React
description:
Tech Lead | React Web

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.



Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?



Qual será o seu papel?

Você atuará como Tech Lead React Web, sendo a referência técnica do time e também alguém que trabalha de forma ativa no desenvolvimento. Seu papel envolve orientar a equipe, garantir a qualidade das entregas, apoiar decisões técnicas, participar de entrevistas, promover as melhores práticas de frontend e assegurar que processos, documentação e ritmo de evolução do time estejam sempre alinhados. Além de liderar, você colocará a mão na massa na construção de interfaces, criação de componentes escaláveis e manutenção de uma base sólida de frontend, contribuindo diretamente para a experiência do usuário e para a evolução contínua do projeto.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Alinhar e acompanhar objetivos do time, garantindo que os processos da Rethink sejam seguidos;
  • Acompanhar a evolução das tarefas ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento, identificando riscos para a entrega e atuando para mitigá-los;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento web, criando componentes reutilizáveis e escaláveis com React, desenvolvendo interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, e colaborando com design e backend;
  • Identificar e resolver problemas de desempenho para manter interfaces rápidas e confiáveis;
  • Realizar revisões de código, orientar padrões e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) em tecnologias e boas práticas de frontend;
  • Atuar como a principal referência técnica para o time e para o cliente, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e garantindo alinhamento entre necessidades do projeto e capacidades da equipe;
  • Conduzir entrevistas e avaliar candidatos para compor o time de TI sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando que o perfil técnico e comportamental esteja aderente às necessidades do projeto;
  • Garantir que o time mantenha atualizadas as ferramentas e artefatos essenciais ao fluxo de trabalho, como Jira, documentações e registros de processo, preservando organização, histórico e visibilidade;

title: Remote Data Scientist (ML) - 52621
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).
  • Proven track record on coding platforms — e.g., top percentile or strong rating on LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle competitions.
  • Experience with system design, clean architecture, and performance optimization.
  • Working level Proficiency in either Machine Learning or Data Science for Machine Learning.


Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.
  • Deep curiosity for performance tuning, scalability, and elegant code design.


Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week with 4-hour PST overlap (options: 20, 30, or 40 hrs/week).
  • Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
  • Duration: 3 months (start date: next week).


Evaluation Process:

  • Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.


After applying, you’ll receive a login link by email. Please complete your profile promptly so we can proceed with your application.


We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at turing.com/referrals and earn money for successful referrals.

description:

Nossos valores — Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia — orientam todas as nossas decisões.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Nosso processo seletivo é inclusivo e aberto a profissionais de todas as identidades, experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

No conforto da sua casa — regime 100% Home Office .

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior (Node.js/TypeScript)
description:
Quem somos?


Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto - SP, com a missão de tornar as organizações da saúde mais eficientes, possibilitando a melhor assistência aos pacientes. Queremos ser reconhecidos como uma das maiores provedoras de serviços de informações a operadores de saúde!


No nosso ambiente de trabalho, procuramos sempre agir com base nos nossos valores. É através deles que chegaremos mais perto de alcançar nossos objetivos:

Qual o desafio?


Buscamos uma pessoa com visão arquitetural e experiência em alta escalabilidade para elevar o nível técnico do nosso time. Você terá papel fundamental na definição de padrões de engenharia e na construção de sistemas robustos que impactam diretamente a eficiência do setor de saúde.


O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia?


Sua missão vai além de escrever código: você será uma referência técnica dentro da Carefy.


  • Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;
  • Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;
  • Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (NestJS/Next.js);
  • Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;
  • Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;
  • Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.


Qual o contexto?


Você fará parte do nosso time de integração. Somos os responsáveis pela interoperabilidade da Carefy. Nossa missão é conectar nossa plataforma aos ecossistemas heterogêneos das operadoras de saúde, garantindo que os dados fluam com segurança e performance. Neste time, você atuará como referência técnica : participando diretamente do desenho de soluções junto aos times de TI dos clientes e, internamente, traduzindo esses desafios complexos em uma arquitetura limpa e em demandas organizadas para orientar o desenvolvimento.


O que esperamos de você?


  • Visão Sistêmica: Capacidade de enxergar o impacto de uma decisão técnica em todo o ecossistema do produto.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Habilidade de negociar soluções técnicas com clientes externos e guiar o time interno com clareza.
  • Autonomia com Responsabilidade: Habilidade para tocar projetos complexos com pouca supervisão, gerenciando riscos.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Foco na causa raiz e em soluções definitivas.


Quais são os requisitos?


  • Mínimo de 6 anos de experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência de 4+ anos com Node.js e TypeScript em produção;
  • Experiência de 4+ anos Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL) , incluindo modelagem e otimização;
  • Experiência comprovada com Arquitetura de Software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD);
  • Experiência prática com Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e serviços de Mensageria (RabbitMQ/Kafka) ;
  • Experiência na criação e manutenção de APIs RESTful escaláveis;
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta criticidade e volume de dados;
  • Domínio de frameworks modernos como NestJS e/ou Next.js ;
  • Conhecimento prático em testes automatizados (TDD , testes unitários e de integração);
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa.


Será um diferencial:


  • Experiência com PHP: Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;
  • Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
  • Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).


O que oferecemos?


  • Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido (para residentes em Ribeirão Preto e região) ou 100% Remoto (para candidatos de outras localidades);
  • Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;
  • Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VA e VR);
  • Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;
  • Horários flexíveis;
  • Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!


Faça parte da nossa revolução na saúde!

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Senior Cloud SRE
description:
Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer

As a Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer , you will join a specialized engineering task force dedicated to preventing and resolving the most critical and strategic customer issues encountered in the field.

Our global team of experienced engineers has a deep understanding of the lower layers of private cloud infrastructure. Together, we work on practical solutions, continuously learning and adapting. We collaborate closely, share knowledge, and tackle challenges head-on.

If you're an engineer eager to understand the core of cloud technologies and looking for a team that values hands-on expertise , you'll fit right in with us.


What you will learn and contribute to

  • Maintain and enhance Red Hat private cloud: You’ll work extensively with Nokia Container Services (NCS) and CloudBand Infrastructure Software (CBIS) , private cloud solutions based on Kubernetes and OpenStack .
  • Deep Dive Troubleshooting: Starting from high-level Kubernetes error messages, you’ll navigate through multiple layers until pinpointing issues—even down to kernel-level bugs.
  • Automate and Develop: Spend 30–50% of your time developing automation to prevent recurring issues. Solve it once, automate for the future. Use your Python skills to create health checks and improve reliability.
  • Continuous Learning: In our rapidly evolving tech landscape, ongoing learning is a cornerstone.
  • Collaborate with Developers and Engineers: Work closely with developers and product engineers to bridge infrastructure and software, ensuring seamless product delivery.
  • Mode of Operation: This role requires participation in a follow-the-sun scheme with 12-hour shifts (within regulatory limits) or participation in on-call rotations to ensure business continuity during emergencies.


Your skills and experience

  • Linux Expertise: Strong familiarity with Linux distributions; we primarily use Red Hat and CentOS .
  • Networking Foundations: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (VLANs, IP routing). Experience with Calico , Multus , and Open vSwitch is a plus.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Excellent troubleshooting skills and analytical thinking to address complex challenges.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in Bash and Python , or willingness to learn, plus familiarity with Ansible .
  • Containerization & Virtualization: Knowledge of Podman , Kubernetes , Helm , and/or OpenStack ; experience with KVM/QEMU is advantageous.
  • Storage Systems: Experience with Ceph and Rook is highly valued.
  • Database Expertise: Understanding of relational databases (MySQL , MariaDB ) and experience with etcd .
  • Monitoring and Logging: Familiarity with tools like ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) , Prometheus , and Grafana .
  • Advanced written and spoken English.


It would be nice if you also had

  • Proactive thinking and ownership mindset.
  • Strong focus on quality and reliability.
  • Passion for delivering training or knowledge-sharing sessions to operations teams.



Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Recruiter
description:
Apesar de ter muitas aplicações não deixe de se aplicar, focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate.


Regime: PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral


Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.


O ano de 2025 foi ótimo para nós, crescemos 155% e mais que dobramos nosso time de operações!


Buscamos novas pessoas para nosso time de recrutamento que queiram fazer parte desse crescimento acelerado:


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas


Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive/tech search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.


Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 4.500 – 12.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$6.500 - 9.000), sem teto.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our HR team. This professional will be responsible for identifying and assessing the different profiles (Technical and Non-technical). We are looking for proactive, dynamic people and team players, with great organizational capacity, accustomed to handling multiple tasks, and with marked attention to detail. It is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!


Key responsibilities:


- Review online information of candidates to assess their general fit.

- Contact candidates through phone calls, Skype, LinkedIn, or mail to validate their interest and motivate them to participate in our process.

- Schedule internal interviews, send the invites, and keep the system records updated.

- Interview candidates to assess their qualifications by validating their profile, experience, interests, commitment, and logic and common sense questions.

- Schedule and confirm technical interviews.

- Follow up with the candidates throughout the process.

- Adapt to a fast-paced and constantly changing environment.


Requirements:


- 2+ previous years of work experience. Previous experience in recruiting roles is a plus.

- Good communication skills, especially in listening and persuasion.

- Time management and organization.

- Flexibility and adaptability to constant changes.

- Working experience in online and phone sales techniques (is a plus).

- Knowledge in IT Industry head-hunting (is a plus).

- Advanced English Level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Performance Static Designer
description:
ReciMe is a recipe app revolutionizing how cooks organize, plan and shop their recipes. Our smart importing tool enables users to aggregate all their recipes in one platform within seconds - whether those recipes came from an Instagram video, recipe blog or grandma’s recipe box.


We’ve been a Top 10 app in the US App Store’s Food category for months and were recently featured on The Drew Barrymore Show.


Now, we’re looking for a Performance Static Designer to join our team!


You’ll be responsible for creating static and carousel ads for Instagram, Facebook, Tiktok and Pinterest.

You’ll work closely with our marketing team to adapt content for different platforms, test variations, and bring ad concepts to life. Your designs will play a key role in driving engagement, conversions, and brand growth.

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 51671


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .

title: Network Automation Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Network Automation Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable automation frameworks that ensure the quality, reliability, and continuous delivery of network and software services. This role focuses on developing robust automated test solutions, integrating them into CI/CD pipelines, and driving end-to-end test coverage across web, API, and network layers. The ideal candidate combines strong automation expertise with modern DevOps practices and familiarity with AI-enabled full-stack development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, reusable automated test frameworks for network and software systems.
  • Implement and maintain automation for web, API, and network layers.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and Xray to validate APIs, software components, and end-to-end service workflows.
  • Develop scalable automation solutions to support continuous delivery and high-quality releases.
  • Monitor automation pipelines, analyze failures, and maintain regression test suites to ensure system stability.
  • Collaborate with network engineers, developers, and DevOps teams to embed quality into the development lifecycle.
  • Leverage AI tools and techniques to enhance automation, testing, and application workflows where applicable.


Required Technical Skills

  • Python
  • Jinja2
  • YANG models for network automation and validation
  • Robot Framework / Pytest
  • Understanding of typing and data modeling
  • Test case design and behavior-driven development (BDD)
  • CI/CD pipeline integration
  • Git-based source control management
  • Pipeline monitoring, reporting, and regression management
  • Familiarity with AI tools and frameworks is beneficial
  • Experience integrating AI capabilities into applications is beneficial

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Summary:

We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python)
  • Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework.
  • Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity.
  • Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.g., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience.
  • Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management
  • Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes.
  • Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance.
  • Data Querying and Performance Optimization
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
  • Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).
  • User Experience (UX) and Data Design
  • Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.
  • Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git.
  • Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly.


Requirements:

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience working with Shiny for Python or similar interactive visualization frameworks such as Plotly, Dash, or Shiny for R , including building interactive dashboards and understanding core concepts like reactivity and UI/server architecture.
  • Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources.
  • Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.
  • Experience with other BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Cloud Architecture Consultant (AWS – HIPAA)
description:
About You

You are a Cloud Architect who enjoys owning architectural decisions and designing secure, scalable, and compliant cloud solutions. You thrive in regulated environments and are comfortable balancing hands-on technical work with strategic thinking. You’re motivated by building robust AWS architectures that meet strict security and compliance requirements—especially in healthcare-related contexts—and by collaborating closely with engineering, security, and compliance teams to deliver reliable cloud platforms.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong professional experience as a Cloud Architect on AWS , owning end-to-end architectural decisions.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services , including Lightsail .
  • Experience working with cPanel-based environments hosted on AWS.
  • Solid knowledge of HIPAA compliance and proven experience designing and maintaining HIPAA-compliant cloud architectures on AWS.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security best practices, including identity and access management, encryption, network security, and data protection.
  • Experience implementing and reviewing security controls aligned with regulatory and compliance requirements.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, security, and compliance teams.
  • Strong documentation skills for architecture designs, decisions, and compliance considerations.
  • Comfortable providing technical guidance and architectural leadership across teams.
  • Excellent English communication skills for working with US-based stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement secure, scalable, and compliant AWS cloud architectures.
  • Build, maintain, and evolve HIPAA-compliant architectures, following AWS best practices and approved services.
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, and compliance teams to ensure solutions meet regulatory and technical standards.
  • Define and enforce security controls, including encryption, access management, and network protections.
  • Review and optimize existing AWS environments for performance, reliability, security, and cost-efficiency.
  • Document cloud architectures, technical decisions, and compliance-related considerations clearly and consistently.
  • Provide architectural leadership and technical guidance to development and infrastructure teams.
  • Support continuous improvement of cloud standards, patterns, and best practices across the organization.


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

title: Azure / Windows Architect
description:
Job Title: Azure/Windows Architect

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type: Contract


Key responsibilities:

  • Lead Azure migrations: Conduct on‑prem/public cloud infra assessments using Azure Migrate and drive solutioning for large, complex Azure migrations.
  • Design landing zones: Understand customer infra landscape; design and build Azure Landing Zones aligned to business, application, and infrastructure strategies.
  • Architect & document: Provide Azure target architecture (HLD/LLD), BoM pricing, licensing details, and clear TCO/ROI rationale.
  • Migrate & troubleshoot: Migrate on‑prem workloads to Azure; troubleshoot Azure/Windows issues across processor, networking, clusters, I/O, and memory.
  • Define end‑to‑end solutions: Realize solution architecture addressing business processes, regulatory needs, quality attributes, and cost efficiency.
  • Windows services expertise: Administer and troubleshoot Windows File/Print, DNS, WINS, DHCP, clustering, DFS; perform upgrades, backups, and restorations.
  • Team leadership: Govern and technically guide infra teams (5+ members); provide 24×7 support and work in shifts.
  • Stakeholder collaboration: Work with internal/customer stakeholders and PMs across banking, healthcare, and insurance domains; ensure risks are mitigated and lessons captured post‑project.


Must have skills:

  • Experience: 13+ years in IT; 5+ years in Azure Infra, Azure Migrate, Azure Networking (IaaS/PaaS), DC/Cloud/Security/SIAM/Data/Storage.
  • Azure services: Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM, Landing Zone design, BoM/pricing/licensing, TCO/ROI.
  • Windows administration: File/Print, DNS, WINS, DHCP, clustering, DFS; server consolidation, upgrades, backup/restore.
  • Migration & troubleshooting: On‑prem to Azure via Azure Migrate; deep troubleshooting in Azure & Windows environments.
  • Leadership & support: Team governance (5+), stakeholder management, 24×7 support readiness, shift flexibility.


Good to have:

  • Certifications: AZ‑305 (Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions), AZ‑104 (Microsoft Azure Administrator).
  • Design exposure: DR/business continuity, identity/governance/monitoring solutions; solution presentations and customer communication.

title: Tech Lead React
description:
Tech Lead | React Web

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.



Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?



Qual será o seu papel?

Você atuará como Tech Lead React Web, sendo a referência técnica do time e também alguém que trabalha de forma ativa no desenvolvimento. Seu papel envolve orientar a equipe, garantir a qualidade das entregas, apoiar decisões técnicas, participar de entrevistas, promover as melhores práticas de frontend e assegurar que processos, documentação e ritmo de evolução do time estejam sempre alinhados. Além de liderar, você colocará a mão na massa na construção de interfaces, criação de componentes escaláveis e manutenção de uma base sólida de frontend, contribuindo diretamente para a experiência do usuário e para a evolução contínua do projeto.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Alinhar e acompanhar objetivos do time, garantindo que os processos da Rethink sejam seguidos;
  • Acompanhar a evolução das tarefas ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento, identificando riscos para a entrega e atuando para mitigá-los;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento web, criando componentes reutilizáveis e escaláveis com React, desenvolvendo interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, e colaborando com design e backend;
  • Identificar e resolver problemas de desempenho para manter interfaces rápidas e confiáveis;
  • Realizar revisões de código, orientar padrões e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) em tecnologias e boas práticas de frontend;
  • Atuar como a principal referência técnica para o time e para o cliente, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e garantindo alinhamento entre necessidades do projeto e capacidades da equipe;
  • Conduzir entrevistas e avaliar candidatos para compor o time de TI sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando que o perfil técnico e comportamental esteja aderente às necessidades do projeto;
  • Garantir que o time mantenha atualizadas as ferramentas e artefatos essenciais ao fluxo de trabalho, como Jira, documentações e registros de processo, preservando organização, histórico e visibilidade;
  • Identificar oportunidades de capacitação e necessidades de desenvolvimento do time, promovendo nivelamento técnico e incentivando uma evolução contínua e estruturada da equipe;
  • Apoiar o time de projetos na elaboração de cronogramas e estimativas, trazendo visão técnica para planejar entregas, dimensionar esforço e antecipar riscos;
  • Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, aplicando boas práticas de UX/UI e garantindo uma experiência fluida, inclusiva e eficiente para o usuário;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento web, guiando decisões técnicas, garantindo a adoção de boas práticas e assegurando que o produto avance com qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Domínio no desenvolvimento frontend utilizando React e seu ecossistema (Redux, React Router, Context API etc.);
  • Experiência com HTML5, CSS3 e pré-processadores de CSS (ex: SASS, LESS);
  • Familiaridade com testes de frontend (ex: Jest, React Testing Library).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de User Experience (UX) e User Interface (UI);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código, preferencialmente Git;
  • Conhecimento em prototipagem de interfaces utilizando Figma ou outras ferramentas de design;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful, com práticas de DevOps e pipelines de CI/CD aplicadas ao frontend;
  • Proatividade, perfil comunicativo, resolução de problemas complexos e busca por melhoria contínua.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com TypeScript;
  • Tiver experiência com gerenciamento de dependências usando NPM e/ou YARN;
  • Conhecer bibliotecas de UI como Material UI, Ant Design ou similares;
  • Aplicar práticas de acessibilidade seguindo diretrizes como WCAG;
  • Tiver vivência com integrações em nuvem (AWS ou outras plataformas);
  • Conhecer princípios de SEO aplicados a aplicações web;
  • Tiver experiência com arquitetura de projetos complexos.



O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento

  • Experiência em projetos de Data Analytics, BI ou Engenharia de Dados.

  • Conhecimento em plataforma de dados Google Cloud, incluindo:

Diferenciais:

title: Content Specialist
description:
Our purpose


ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.


Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.


Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all.

Who we are


We’re a real tech success story, built from the ground up with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.


Through our years, we’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from the ground up... with our own team.


Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.



The Opportunity


The Content Specialist is an exciting role in ecoPortal’s marketing team, directly contributing to our content strategy. You’ll be part of a team with big aspirations, changing perceptions of health and safety worldwide.



Ideal for someone who has:


  • A Bachelors (or higher) Degree in marketing/ journalism/ communications or similar major.
  • Exceptional written and verbal English fluency.
  • A strong understanding of SEO and CRO copywriting.
  • A flair for story-telling, with the ability to demonstrate technical writing.
  • A passion for writing with an excellent eye for detail, grammar, brand tone and style.
  • Experience in marketing in a tech and/or SaaS company is an advantage.
  • An understanding of the buyer journey and how best to capture people's interest at each stage.
  • Experience in managing Podcasts, Webinars and live content events.
  • The ability to meet deadlines, be a self-starter and have a can-do attitude.
  • Great communication skills, with the ability to liaise with both internal and external stakeholders regularly.


Key Responsibilities


  • Execution of the company’s content strategy, with the aim of educating, engaging, entertaining and empowering people across the company’s full customer lifecycle.
  • Be a driving force behind the execution of a broad range of top-notch content including ad campaigns, web copy, email marketing, blogs, case studies, webinars, event collateral, videos and more.
  • Planning webinar and podcast series and managing all production aspects, from prospecting and inviting potential speakers to writing briefings and scripts and supporting the recording or live delivery.
  • Creation of compelling monthly and quarterly newsletters, with ongoing performance tracking and a focus on finding new ways to improve engagement.
  • Keep your finger on the pulse of what’s front of mind for professionals in the world of health and safety and use that to input on content and campaign idea generation.
  • Support the Sales and Success teams by creating targeted collateral, emails, social posts and case studies to drive conversions and upsell opportunities;
  • Support the company’s SEO initiatives, scope and create content that helps the company get found via organic traffic;
  • Contribute to ecoPortal’s content strategy and execution.
  • Take a campaign approach to content development. Implement SEO best practices, test, and iterate your content and creative processes with the aim of increasing ecoPortal’s reach, generating demand, and converting prospects to customers.
  • Support other team-wide initiatives with targeted collateral (i.e. web, email) that leverages strong storytelling to get key ecoPortal messages across in inspiring and unique ways;
  • Keep your work in Trello and the content calendar up-to-date and set up other administrative processes as required;
  • Closely monitor new content trends, and proactively seek creative opportunities where these can be best utilised at the company.
  • Own and manage our content partnership relationships, agreements and event partner content.
  • Collaborate with other Creative Team members, including Graphic Designers, Video Specialists, as well as members of the Digital Marketing Team.
  • Contribute to brand and content reporting as required.
  • Support the Content Marketing Manager and wider marketing team in other areas of the business that align with your skillset as required.



Perks & Benefits:


We hope that you're excited by the possibilities that come with working at ecoPortal! In addition to our welcoming and diverse culture, we also offer these fun perks and benefits.


37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.


End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️


Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training.


❤️
