title: Salesforce Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with 30 years of experience, is seeking a Salesforce OEM Application Developer to support a US-based customer. This position collaborates with development teams in the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, focusing on designing, developing, and maintaining a managed Salesforce OEM application.


This role is ideal for someone with deep Salesforce development expertise, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly in English.


About the Role:


As a Salesforce OEM Application Developer, you will work closely with product managers, clients, and internal teams to gather and refine technical requirements, translate business needs into robust application features, and maintain a secure, scalable Salesforce OEM solution. You will develop advanced functionality combining code and configuration, manage integrations and data migrations, troubleshoot application-level issues, and support packaging, versioning, and upgrades of the managed application.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and maintain a managed Salesforce OEM application using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tools.
  • Build advanced Salesforce functionality, including complex Flows, triggers, asynchronous processing, and Community/Experience Cloud implementations .
  • Architect scalable and secure solutions aligned with Salesforce OEM/ISV best practices , including multi-tenant considerations and upgrade-safe design.
  • Develop and maintain custom data models, integrations, and automation , ensuring performance, governor-limit compliance, and maintainability.
  • Manage data migration and transformation processes using Apex, ETL tools, and Salesforce APIs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application-level issues including Apex logic, automation conflicts, and deployment errors.
  • Build test classes with strong code coverage and participate in CI/CD and release management activities.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation , including architecture workbooks, developer/admin guides, testing strategies, and deployment protocols.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Administrators and customer technical teams to ensure correct configuration and extension of the OEM application.


Required Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on Salesforce development experience , including Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Proven experience blending programmatic development and declarative configuration for scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Experience designing and implementing advanced Flows, triggers, and automation based on business rules.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, security, permissions, sharing models, and performance optimization .
  • Experience collaborating with stakeholders to design sophisticated user experiences across screens, records, and automation processes.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and modern release practices .
  • Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I/II, Administrator or Advanced Administrator (Platform App Builder preferred).
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills in English.
  • Familiarity with C# and the .NET ecosystem for backend services or integrations.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AI-assisted development workflows for code generation, testing, or documentation.
  • Prior experience building or supporting OEM/ISV applications , including managed packages, AppExchange distribution, or Salesforce Security Review preparation.
  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. Our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.


Who are You ?


You are relentlessly committed to delivering exceptional partner support, combining deep technical knowledge with sharp analytical skills to resolve issues efficiently and prevent them from recurring. You excel at interpreting data, logs, and system behavior to uncover root causes and provide clear, actionable insights to both partners and internal teams.


A confident and influential communicator, you build strong relationships with operators, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. You thrive on translating complex technical details into understandable guidance, ensuring that partners always feel supported and informed.


Where you Fit In:


We are seeking a proactive and technically strong B2B Technical Support Specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you will leverage your deep understanding of the iGaming industry and your strong analytical mindset to troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve issues reported by our operators and internal stakeholders.


Working closely with the ITSM department — and reporting directly to the Technical Support Team Lead — you will be a key player in ensuring high-quality, timely support. Your ability to interpret logs, analyze platform behavior, communicate clearly, and escalate effectively will help maintain platform reliability and deliver an exceptional partner experience.


You will thrive in a fast-paced environment where attention to detail, technical curiosity, and a commitment to service excellence are essential. Your work will be pivotal in strengthening partner trust, improving operational stability, and supporting our mission to deliver a seamless and compliant gaming experience worldwide.


The impact you will have:


  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for B2B operators, platform partners, and integrators, ensuring their issues are resolved quickly, accurately, and with minimal business impact.
  • Perform in-depth technical troubleshooting across game integrations, wallet systems, API calls, transaction flows, and platform services — using logs, monitoring tools, and diagnostics to identify root causes.
  • Identify, flag, and track repetitive issues or recurring error patterns, escalating them with clear technical context to drive permanent fixes.
  • Ensure all partner interactions, escalations, and resolutions align with regulatory requirements, internal controls, and jurisdictional rules — maintaining strong compliance awareness at all times.
  • Coordinate cross-team escalations ensuring that complex issues are escalated and documented clearly and progressed efficiently.
  • Stay current with industry standards, emerging technologies, and best practices across iGaming, payments, and platform operations, recommending improvements to processes and tooling.
  • Champion adoption of shared support frameworks — authoring playbooks, SLA policies, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles to standardize excellence across the organization.


What we’re looking for:


  • Experience in B2B Technical Support within the Casino or iGaming sector.
  • Strong understanding of iGaming systems such as game aggregation, wallet services, RNG, bonus engines, player tracking, and jurisdictional compliance.
  • Experience working with logs, monitoring tools, and debugging complex integration issues.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cases, partners, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent English communication and presentation skills.
  • Hands-on experience with common support tooling (ex: Jira, Grafana, Kibana, etc.).


This role is remote and based in Brazil.


Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Lead Software Engineer to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Brazil - Remote

Industry: IT & Services.


This position requires advanced communication skills in English, both written and verbal.


Lead Software Engineer | About You

As a Lead Software Engineer, you are responsible for driving the technical vision behind scalable, modern applications while guiding a high‑performing engineering team. You’re someone who thrives at the intersection of architecture, hands‑on development, and mentorship, balancing strategic decision‑making with a passion for building exceptional software. You enjoy shaping engineering standards, elevating team capabilities, and making thoughtful choices that influence long-term product success. You’re motivated by solving complex technical challenges and creating environments where engineers can do their best work.


Lead Software Engineer | Day-to-Day

  • Lead the design and development of complex, scalable applications using .NET and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular or React.
  • Define engineering standards, best practices, and architectural guidelines for the development team.
  • Architect and maintain secure, high‑availability cloud-based systems optimized for performance.
  • Partner with Product, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure alignment between technical solutions and business goals.
  • Mentor engineers, fostering continuous learning, quality craftsmanship, and knowledge sharing.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to quality, security, and maintainability standards.
  • Solve advanced technical challenges and influence decisions related to architecture and technology stack selection.


Lead Software Engineer | Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with advanced proficiency in .NET and modern JavaScript frameworks (Angular or React).
  • Proven experience leading engineering teams and collaborating effectively across functions.
  • Strong expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern web development standards.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and optimizing applications on AWS or other major cloud platforms.
  • Deep understanding of system architecture, design patterns, and scalable application principles.
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP Full Stack - PL/SR
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Buscamos um(a) profissional SAP FullStack (Pleno ou Sênior) para atuar em ambientes SAP S/4HANA, com foco em desenvolvimento moderno utilizando o modelo RAP e aplicações Fiori. A posição envolve atuação ponta a ponta, desde a camada de dados e serviços até a interface, colaborando com arquitetos e consultores funcionais em times ágeis ou híbridos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver soluções SAP FullStack no ambiente S/4HANA.
  • Implementar serviços utilizando o modelo RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Criar e manter CDS Views (projection, exposure e behavior) e Behavior Definitions.
  • Desenvolver Service Definitions e Service Bindings com exposição via OData V4.
  • Construir aplicações com Fiori Elements.
  • Atuar com ABAP OO seguindo boas práticas de Clean Code e qualidade de código.
  • Realizar revisões de código e aplicar padrões de qualidade e sustentabilidade técnica.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos, consultores funcionais e times ágeis.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prática com SAP S/4HANA.
  • Domínio do modelo RAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em ABAP Orientado a Objetos.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuação em times ágeis ou híbridos.
  • Mentalidade orientada a Clean Code, qualidade e manutenção evolutiva.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Participação em pelo menos uma implementação greenfield de SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ATC, SCI ou outras ferramentas de qualidade de código.
  • Certificações SAP.
  • Inglês intermediário/ avançado.


Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto no Brasil

Viagens pontoais (2-3 vezes ao ano)


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Analista de Projetos Sênior
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Sobre a área: O escritório de projetos atua na padronização de processos de governanç arelacionados ag estão de projetos, facilitando o compartilhamento de reports, metodologias, ferramentas e técnicas para alcançar o desafio deimplementar iniciativas com sucesso. O Analista de Projetos elabora planos de execução e acompanha deperto os projetos do Grupo Fleury, atuando também no controle e nos estudos, garantindo que todas asinformações obtidas desse projeto sejam registradas e estejam em um local de fácil consulta


Principais atividades:


  • Realizar detalhamento do escopo do projeto, levantamento dos requisitos técnicos/funcionais relacionados aos projetos, mapear stakeholders e analisar, criticamente, a relevância e impacto em valor gerado, a fim de atender as necessidades do negócio;
  • Elaborar documentação, relatórios, atas, listas de pendências e outros registros a fim de garantir
  • rastreabilidade dos projetos, conforme metodologia estabelecida pelo Escritório de Projetos (PMO);
  • Analisar e acompanhar de forma diligente o escopo do projeto através de ferramentas de gerenciamento de projetos e gerenciamento das eventuais mudanças, a fim de garantir a efetividade das ações definidas;
  • Garantir integração, comunicação e colaboração entre os membros do projeto e os stakeholdersatravés da elaboração Status Report e/ou ações de Gestão da Mudança, a fim de garantir alinhamento, atendimento aos requisitos, entregas acordadas e prazos estabelecidos;
  • Gerenciar testes, pilotos e acompanhar a implantação em produção dos projetos, a fim de garantir a preservação da operação existente;
  • Definir e acompanhar critérios de aceitação nas entregas, a fim de garantir a qualidade e atendimento de expectativas acordadas;
  • Acompanhar o orçamento do projeto, através da análise/custeio dos recursos necessários e dos custos ao longo do projeto, identificando e corrigindo os possíveis desvios;
  • Identificar, acompanhar e atualizar os riscos do projeto através de controle do projeto, dos planos de respostas aos riscos e do plano de gerenciamento, a fim de mitigar e reduzir os impactos;
  • Acompanhar a execução dos projetos pelos fornecedores visando garantir a aderência ao contrato Firmado.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Pacote Office – intermediário
  • MS Project – básico
  • Métodos ágeis – básico
  • Experiência prévia na condução de projetos de diferentes portes e complexidades
  • Superior Completo (Administração, Engenharia, TI ou áreas correlatas)?MBA em Gestão de Projetos (desejável)


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito


Informações da vaga:

  • Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)
  • Carga Horária: 44h Semanais
  • Escala: Segunda a sexta - feira
  • Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

title: Brand Designer Pleno
description:
Cód.57182


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Designer, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Domínio das ferramentas Adobe: Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects e Premiere.
  • Experiência prévia em design gráfico/motion, preferencialmente em áreas de marketing ou comunicação interna.
  • Capacidade de aplicar e desdobrar identidade visual da marca em diferentes pontos de contato e materiais.
  • Experiência na produção de vídeos, motions, apresentações institucionais e comerciais.
  • Habilidade para conduzir demandas de design de ponta a ponta (criação, adaptação, desdobramento visual e entrega), alinhando-se às diretrizes da marca e aos objetivos de marketing e endomarketing.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

title: Cloud Engineer - Kubernetes (Home Office)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Kubernetes Engineer to work remotely for one of our clients. This is a role with a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries.


Job location: Remote, work anywhere from Brazil.


This job requires excellent English, written and spoken. Please submit a resume in English and be prepared for English language interviews throughout the process.


The Kubernetes Engineer plays a critical role in designing, building, operating, and securing our client's container platforms, with a focus on Kubernetes-based PaaS (Platform as a Service) environments. This role ensures high availability, performance, security, and lifecycle management of Kubernetes platforms across Lab, Non-Prod, and Production environments. The Kubernetes Engineer works cross‑functionally with cloud, cybersecurity, compute, network, and application teams to deliver resilient and automated platform services aligned with Product Management and CCOE strategies


Key Responsibilities :

Platform Engineering & Operations

  • Design, build, and operate Kubernetes clusters (on‑prem and/or cloud) following standard reference architectures.
  • Implement and maintain Kubernetes add‑ons, CSI storage drivers, CNI network plugins, and ingress controllers.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and reliability of Kubernetes clusters and workloads.
  • Perform lifecycle upgrades of Kubernetes, OS, infrastructure software (GKE, Rancher), and supporting components.
  • Manage persistent storage solutions including migration to Dell CSI‑enabled PowerStore and Portworx.
  • Manage hardware lifecycle work for Kubernetes‑backed compute environments.

Security, Compliance & Cybersecurity Alignment

  • Implement and maintain vulnerability remediation workflows to achieve >90% SecureLens compliance.
  • Enable PAM authentication across Kubernetes and supporting OS layers.
  • Ensure clusters and workloads meet cybersecurity, data privacy, and lifecycle compliance requirements.
  • Support audits and remediate non‑compliant configurations.
  • Drive the transition from CentOS to supported and approved OS platforms.

Automation, Standardization & Continuous Improvement

  • Automate repetitive operational tasks, cluster provisioning, workload deployment, configuration, and compliance enforcement.
  • Contribute to product roadmaps, automation frameworks, and standard reference designs.
  • Participate in EPIC initiatives to reduce complexity and increase efficiency.
  • Assist with PPDM migrations for Kubernetes‑based backup workloads.
  • Contribute to patch testing frameworks using canary/ring deployment models.

Platform 3 / CCOE Collaboration & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with CCOE intake, design, and fulfillment teams to deliver frictionless onboarding.
  • Ensure Kubernetes solutions align with lifecycle, security, and platform standards.
  • Conduct workshops and training sessions to extend platform knowledge across Cox.
  • Participate in customer feedback loops, roadshows, and product management routines.
  • Provide timely support for Rancher migrations and eventual decommissioning.

AI & GPU Platform Support

  • Support deployment of GPU‑enabled Kubernetes clusters.
  • Implement automation for provisioning GPU workloads.
  • Validate ServiceNow intake workflows for AI-native tenant designs.

Observability, Reporting & KPIs

  • Enhance New Relic dashboards for Kubernetes reliability and health.
  • Develop and publish right-sizing audit reports for cluster optimization and cost efficiency.
  • Track cluster capacity, growth, and licensing/tool usage.
  • Participate in monthly operational reviews.

title: GenAI Solution Architect
description:
GenAI Solution Architect

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Full Time


In this role, you will:

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.


Technical Expertise:

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI/CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP/REST) and API development.


  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.


Specialized Skills:

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.


Soft Skills and Others:

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

title: Software Architect
description:
Somos uma boutique para modernização e aceleração digital e buscamos Software Architect para fazer parte dessa jornada.


Olha só quais são as experiências e conhecimentos que você precisa ter para acelerar e transformar com a gente:

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Arquitetura e Design da Solução:

  • Escolher padrões arquiteturais adequados (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).
  • Justificar a escolha dos padrões em relação aos requisitos.
  • Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade.
  • Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade).
  • Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência).
  • Atender ao requisito de não indisponibilidade do serviço de controle de lançamentos em caso de falha do consolidado diário. ➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc).
  • Escolher ferramentas de integração adequadas e suas responsabilidades.
  • Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança).
  • Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc).
  • Analisar a qualidade da divisão do sistema em partes menores e gerenciáveis.
  • Abstrair e segregar responsabilidades entre as camadas.


Implementação:

  • Garantir a aderência às boas práticas de desenvolvimento (Solid, Clean Code, etc).
  • Escrever código legível, organizado e de fácil manutenção.
  • Utilizar a linguagem C# de forma eficiente.
  • Implementar testes com boa cobertura, qualidade e relevância.
  • Cumprir os requisitos técnicos obrigatórios.
  • Atender aos requisitos de negócio.


Documentação e Apresentação:

  • Documentar a arquitetura de forma clara e concisa.
  • Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura.
  • Justificar as decisões arquiteturais.
  • Definir os fluxos de dados.
  • Escrever instruções claras e detalhadas de como a aplicação funciona e como rodar localmente (Readme).
  • Centralizar documentações.
  • Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões do sistema.
  • Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo.
  • Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.


Diferenciais e Boas Práticas:

  • Garantir que o código seja executado de forma local e sem erros.
  • Utilizar estratégias de Docker e Docker Compose.
  • Implementar pipeline automatizada (CI/CD).
  • Utilizar estratégias de IaC (Infraestrutura como Código).
  • Realizar estimativas de custos.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Experiência:

  • Experiência comprovada em design e implementação de arquiteturas de software escaláveis, resilientes e seguras.
  • Experiência prática em desenvolvimento de software utilizando a linguagem C#.
  • Experiência com a aplicação de princípios de design de software (SOLID, Clean Code, etc.).
  • Experiência com a implementação de testes automatizados (unitários, integração, etc.).
  • Experiência com padrões de arquitetura (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).


Conhecimento Técnico:

  • Profundo conhecimento da linguagem C# e do ecossistema .NET.
  • Sólido conhecimento de padrões de design de software (Design Patterns).
  • Conhecimento de princípios de arquitetura de software (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de práticas de desenvolvimento ágil (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git).
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de testes (TDD, BDD).
  • Familiaridade com Docker e Docker Compose.
  • Conhecimento de CI/CD (Integração Contínua / Entrega Contínua).
  • Conhecimento de IaC (Infraestrutura como Código).


Habilidades:

  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e colaboração para trabalhar em equipe.
  • Habilidade de análise crítica e resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas.
  • Habilidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos.
  • Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada.
  • Capacidade de aprender e se adaptar a novas tecnologias e ferramentas.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field

title: Engenheiro de dados SR
description:
A Stone:

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.


Como é ser um Egenheiro de Dados:

O Engenheiro de Dados será responsável por construir, implantar e otimizar pipelines de dados confiáveis e escaláveis, garantindo que os dados brutos sejam transformados em informações úteis e acessíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e segmentação de jornadas no contexto de CRM. O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analistas de negócios e equipes de TI para suportar diversas iniciativas orientadas por dados.


As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver fluxos automatizados e confiáveis para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de diversas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a qualidade e a integridade dos dados, identificando e corrigindo falhas na estrutura para evitar comprometimento das análises e jornadas.
  • Otimizar performance: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e implementar melhorias para garantir o processamento rápido e eficiente de consultas e análises.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em SQL (Procedures, DML, DDL, Pipelines) & Python.
  • Plataformas de Nuvem: Experiência com serviços de nuvem (GCP, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para armazenamento e processamento de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow e Cloud Functions.
  • Engenharia de Software: Conhecimento em boas práticas de codificação, versionamento (Git) e testes.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas e Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade analítica para identificar gargalos, depurar sistemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes de forma proativa.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Clareza para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos (como times de negócios e gestão), e vice-versa, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e resultados.
  • Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração: Atuar de forma integrada com engenheiros de dados, analistas e outras equipes, contribuindo para um ambiente produtivo e sinérgico.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em entregar soluções de dados que gerem valor real para o negócio e impulsionam a tomada de decisões.


Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 Segunda à sexta - de 08h às 17h ou de 09h às 18h.


Modelo/Local de trabalho:

  • Remoto

Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.


Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

title: GoHigh Level Specialist
description:
GoHigh Level Specialist

Company: OutfitMD

Department: Operations / Technology

Reports To: CEO & Leadership Team


Role Overview

The GoHigh Level Specialist is responsible for owning, managing, and optimizing the entire backend technology and automation infrastructure for OutfitMD. This role serves as the internal technical authority for CRM systems, workflows, automations, integrations, and platform performance.


This position ensures OutfitMD has full internal control, visibility, and scalability of its systems. The role is highly technical, execution-focused, and critical to the company’s ability to scale efficiently By maintaining strong internal ownership of platform logic and automation, this role enables seamless operations across Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing ensuring systems evolve alongside the business and can reliably support increased volume, complexity, and long-term expansion.


Primary Objectives

• Own and manage OutfitMD’s CRM and automation ecosystem

• Build, maintain, and optimize GHL workflows and automations

• Eliminate dependency on external GHL vendors

• Ensure system stability, scalability, and performance

• Support Implementation, Client Success, and Sales through reliable systems


Core Responsibilities

CRM & Automation Ownership

• Serve as the primary internal expert for GoHighLevel

• Build and maintain workflows, automations, triggers, and pipelines

• Configure forms, calendars, intake processes, and communication logic

• Manage integrations with third-party tools (SMS, email, payment processors, etc.)

• Maintain clean data structures, tagging, and segmentation


Implementation & Technical Support

• Support Implementation Support Specialists with backend builds

• Execute technical setup for new client portals

• Troubleshoot automation failures, bugs, and system issues

• Test and QA systems before client launch


System Optimization & Scaling

• Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and automation gaps

• Optimize workflows for speed, accuracy, and scalability

• Prepare systems to support increased client volume

• Document technical SOPs and system logic


Security, Compliance & Reliability

• Ensure systems follow best practices for data handling and access control

• Manage user permissions and access levels

• Monitor system uptime and automation health


Internal Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales, Implementation, Client Success, and Marketing

• Translate business needs into technical solutions

• Provide leadership with technical insight and recommendations


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Automation reliability and uptime

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Advanced English

• Strong understanding of automation logic and workflows

• Experience with CRM architecture, pipelines, and data structure

• Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently

• Strong documentation and organizational skills

• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical teams


Preferred

The GoHighLevel Specialist ensures our marketing and sales systems run efficiently and produce measurable results. This role is responsible for setting up and optimizing automations, funnels, and CRM workflows so every lead is properly captured, followed up with, and moved through the sales process without manual effort.

By translating business goals into scalable systems, the GoHighLevel Specialist reduces lead loss, improves conversion rates, and supports sustainable growth. This role turns GoHighLevel into a reliable, revenue-driving platform rather than just another software tool.

title: Product Owner
description:
Descrição da vaga

  • Organizar junto as áreas, o desenvolvimento dos produtos e serviços alinhados à estratégia do negócio, com o objetivo de definir e priorizar os requisitos do produto e garantir que o produto atenda às necessidades dos usuários e do negócio. Atuar como um representante dos stakeholders (partes interessadas) e trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o time de desenvolvimento para garantir que o produto atenda às necessidades do cliente e do negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Analisar, interpretar e construir a documentação e informações de sistemas compreendendo processos e regras de negócio mapeados, contribuindo para a definição da arquitetura e implementação da solução para atendimento das necessidades de negócio existentes;
  • Mapear, refinar e documentar regras de negócio, requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, histórias de usuário relativas ao produto;
  • Contextualizar funcionalidades e sistemas à processos e regras de negócio, demonstrando análise crítica e empenho no seu esclarecimento para suportar sua correta implementação;
  • Ser capaz de mapear os pontos de integração da solução e dos processos;
  • Orientar a análise, modelagem e documentação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais;
  • Conduzir o entendimento do problema e definição da solução (processo de discovery: entender, alinhar e comunicar o objetivo do produto) de propostas complexas, de acordo com os critérios de aceite do cliente;
  • Elaborar, priorizar e manter atualizado o roadmap e realizar o gerenciamento e refinamento do backlog de desenvolvimento do projeto/produto.;
  • Construção de fluxos e prototipos de baixa fidelidade;
  • Garantir o entendimento do time de desenvolvimento referente aos itens do backlog do produto;
  • Conduzir os ritos da metodologia utilizada para desenvolvimento do produto (por exemplo ritos do Scrum: Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, Retrospectiva etc.);
  • Realizar o controle de Burn down do projeto;
  • Garantir que os clientes internos e externos estejam alinhados quanto aos prazos e entregas;
  • Acompanhamento, homologação e reporte das entregas;
  • Reporte de informações do projeto a Gerência de Operações e/ou Gerente de Projetos a fim de subsidiar as decisões estratégicas;
  • Identificar e endereçar oportunidades de evolução do produto, para melhor atender as necessidades dos usuários;
  • Cumprir as diretrizes de segurança da informação e compliance estabelecidas pelo Grupo Imagem.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação :

  • Graduado.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios;
  • Capacidade de comunicação e escrita clara, objetiva e organizada;
  • Capacidade de atuar com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de validação das especificações.
  • Conhecimento em acompanhamento e controle de indicadores (KPIs).


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado;
  • Conhecimentos em GIS;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de prototipação;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão em profundidade dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Vega (Tecnologia da Informação ou Agronegócio);
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de apoio para ideação, especificação, prototipação e validação de sistemas;
  • Mapeamento de processos;
  • Metodologias ágeis (exemplo: Framework Scrum etc);
  • Análise de Dados;
  • Conhecimento sobre o CAR (Cadastro Ambiental Rural).


Informações adicionais

Por que escolher a VEGA?

Trabalho 100% Remoto ou Híbrido, se você estiver próximo à nossa sede (São José dos Campos) ou hubs (Lavras e Piracicaba).

Plano de Saúde: Sul América ou Unimed (conforme localidade).

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!



About The Role


Strong financial analysis and forecasting enables Teachable to determine how best to deploy our resources to continue (and accelerate) our growth. The FP&A team oversees the company's financial well-being while supporting operational and business planning in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. We work hard to ensure growth is accurately projected and that our financial results are properly accounted for.

We’re looking for an Senior FP&A Analyst who can help assess the opportunities ahead of us and support all areas of FP&A. This position will be heavily involved in various finance needs of the company, such as data analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling. If you enjoy the challenge of transforming business questions into financial models, please consider joining our team!


Key Responsibilities


  • Own updating and forecasting of Teachable Monthly P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow statements.
  • Put together monthly reporting powerpoint presentations.
  • Own all aspects of SG&A expense, tracking, and reporting internationally for Teachable.
  • Provide full visibility and tracking of company unit economics, and help the business drive operational efficiencies. This includes working closely with cross-functional partners to set targets and monitor performance such as LTV/CAC.
  • Support the finance department with ongoing analysis and forecasting for individual products and the overall company.
  • As needed, work on a variety of ad hoc and special projects that may include product or feature launches, pricing changes, or assessing the viability of new opportunities.


Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree, preferred concentration in finance, accounting, management or related fields .
  • 4+ years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, or investment banking.
  • Advanced Excel Skills such as Power Query
  • Proficient financial, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • BI tooling (Sigma, PowerBI) and SAP experience a plus.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple projects and a willingness to learn.
  • Eagerness to learn and make a meaningful contribution.
  • Excitement to work independently and chart your own course, while knowing when to seek guidance.
  • Fluent english is required.

title: Snowflake Data Engineer
description:
Overview

A US-based financial services organization is seeking an experienced Snowflake Data Engineer to support the ongoing development and optimization of its cloud data platform. This role will focus on building and maintaining scalable ETL pipelines, enforcing strong data governance practices, and preparing the enterprise data warehouse to leverage advanced capabilities such as Snowflake Cortex and Snowflake Intelligence.


This is a hands-on engineering role working closely with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to ensure high-quality, secure, and analytics-ready data.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines within Snowflake to support analytics and downstream use cases
  • Develop and maintain scalable data models to support reporting, BI, and advanced AI/ML workloads
  • Implement and enforce data governance best practices, including data quality, lineage, access controls, and compliance requirements
  • Prepare and structure data to enable future adoption of Snowflake Cortex and Snowflake Intelligence capabilities
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Monitor and improve performance, cost efficiency, and reliability of the Snowflake data warehouse
  • Support documentation and knowledge sharing across the data engineering function


Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience as a Data Engineer working with Snowflake in production environments
  • Proven experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines at scale
  • Solid understanding of data governance, data quality frameworks, and security best practices
  • Experience working in regulated or financial services environments is strongly preferred
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with cloud-based data warehouses


Preferred / Advantageous Skills

  • Experience with modern data tools such as:
  • dbt
  • Fivetran
  • Matillion
  • Apache Airflow
  • Experience collaborating with data science or AI teams

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Machine Learning Engineer to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Brazil - Remote

Industry: IT & Services.


This position requires advanced communication skills in English, both written and verbal.


Machine Learning Engineer | About You

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you are responsible for turning complex data and business challenges into scalable, high‑impact AI solutions. You thrive in environments where experimentation meets engineering rigor, and you take pride in building systems that work reliably in the real world. You are the kind of person who enjoys staying ahead of industry trends—especially in LLMs and generative AI—and bringing that knowledge into practical, production-ready workflows. You’re excited by the opportunity to shape modern ML pipelines end‑to‑end, collaborate deeply with cross-functional teams, and continuously refine how AI drives value across an organization.


Machine Learning Engineer | Day-to-Day

  • Develop and maintain scalable, reproducible machine learning pipelines across preprocessing, training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Build and optimize LLM-based solutions, including RAG approaches, embeddings, and semantic search capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to translate business needs into strong ML/AI system designs.
  • Prototype and deploy ML and deep learning models for transformation, ranking, prediction, and other applied use cases.
  • Design native workflows on AWS using Lambda, Step Functions, SageMaker, Bedrock, AgentCore, and related services.
  • Implement observability and monitoring tools to ensure reliability, stability, and compliance of models in production.


Machine Learning Engineer | Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Machine Learning, with a proven track record deploying end‑to‑end ML/AI systems in production.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS AI/ML services including SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, and Step Functions, along with MLOps best practices.
  • Strong knowledge of LLMs, RAG architectures, embeddings, and vector databases.
  • Proficiency in Python and ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch and scikit‑learn, familiarity with transformer-based models.
  • Solid understanding of model deployment, containerization, and monitoring.
  • Experience with data engineering for ML workflows (feature pipelines, schema versioning, data quality controls).
  • Advanced English proficiency for communication with a global, distributed team.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Azure SQL Solutions Architect (Level P5/P6/P7)

Location: Remote / Hybrid | Experience: 15+ Years | Sector: Enterprise Cloud Transformation

The Mission

Are you a visionary architect who lives at the intersection of Data and Infrastructure ? We are looking for a heavy-hitter to lead massive, high-stakes cloud migrations for some of the world’s largest brands in Banking, Healthcare, and Insurance.

As our SQL Architect , you aren't just moving databases; you are reimagining how global enterprises operate in the cloud. You will be the technical authority responsible for auditing complex legacy environments and architecting the future-state of Azure Data & Infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect the Future: Conduct deep-dive \"AS-IS\" assessments and design sophisticated \"Target State\" architectures that get approved by executive review boards.
  • Lead the Migration: Drive large-scale Azure migration activities, utilizing Azure Migrate to move complex on-prem workloads to the cloud.
  • Master the Landing Zone: Design and build secure, scalable Azure Landing Zones from the ground up, ensuring identity (IAM), security (Key Vault), and governance are baked-in.
  • Blueprint Excellence: Produce high-fidelity HLD (High-Level Design) and LLD (Low-Level Design) documents covering the entire Azure ecosystem.
  • Be the Expert: Provide technical leadership in troubleshooting deep-stack issues (Networking, IO, Clusters) and define the BoM (Bill of Materials) to ensure clients get maximum value for their investment.

What We’re Looking For

  • The Veteran: 15+ years of IT experience, with at least a decade dedicated to the Microsoft Azure ecosystem.
  • The SQL Specialist: Deep, hands-on mastery of Azure SQL (IaaS & PaaS) , Azure Storage, and high-availability data solutions.
  • The Strategist: Experience in Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery (BCDR) and infrastructure-as-code principles.
  • The Communicator: Ability to bridge the gap between deep technical troubleshooting and C-suite stakeholder management.
  • The Industry Expert: Previous success navigating the regulatory complexities of the Banking or Healthcare sectors.

Technical Toolkit

  • Primary: Azure SQL, Azure Migrate, IAM, Key Vault, Storage.
  • Architecture: Mastery of Frameworks (TOGAF or similar), HLD/LLD creation.
  • Certification (The Cherry on Top): AZ-305 (Infrastructure Solutions) or AZ-104 (Administrator).

Why Join Us?

You will work on projects of massive scale where your designs directly impact the security and efficiency of global financial and medical data. This is a role for an architect who wants to own the \"Big Picture\" while staying sharp on the technical details.

Ready to build the next generation of Cloud Infrastructure? Let’s talk.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados SR - Sustentação Open Finance
description:
A ATRA está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados para atuar na sustentação, monitoramento e operação de um ambiente crítico de Open Finance em GCP , garantindo alta confiabilidade, estabilidade operacional e atendimento a requisitos regulatórios, operacionais e de segurança.


Descrição da vaga:

O projeto de Open Finance tem como objetivo garantir a ingestão, processamento, monitoramento e disponibilidade de dados financeiros em ambiente Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Devido à criticidade do ecossistema e à necessidade de alta confiabilidade dos pipelines de dados, o(a) profissional atuará diretamente na operação e sustentação do ambiente, assegurando rápida resposta a incidentes, estabilidade contínua e suporte às áreas envolvidas.


Responsabilidades:

O(a) profissional atuará de ponta a ponta na sustentação do ambiente, incluindo:

- Monitoramento contínuo de pipelines de dados (batch e on-demand).

- Atuação imediata em falhas operacionais e incidentes críticos.

- Análise de logs e troubleshooting em Dataproc, pipelines e DAGs.

- Acompanhamento de cargas, reprocessamentos e validações de dados.

- Interface com times de Engenharia, Arquitetura, Governança e Negócio.

- Apoio em processos de estabilização e melhoria contínua.

- Documentação de incidentes, análises de causa raiz e planos de ação.


Requisitos Técnicos Necessários:

- Experiência sólida com Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

- Domínio de BigQuery (modelagem, performance e gestão de custos).

- Experiência com Dataproc / Apache Spark.

- Vivência com pipelines batch e reprocessamentos.

- Análise de logs e falhas em pipelines de dados.

- Conhecimento em IAM e gestão de permissões.

- Experiência em ambientes críticos ou regulados.

- Continuous Query: processamento contínuo e atualização incremental de dados (streaming ou near real-time).

- Pub/Sub: integração e monitoramento de pipelines orientados a eventos.

- Cloud SQL (MySQL): operação, suporte e análise de bases relacionais.

- Cloud Functions: suporte e manutenção de funções serverless orientadas a eventos.

- Cloud Run: operação e monitoramento de aplicações containerizadas em ambiente serverless.

- Cloud Composer (Airflow): monitoramento, análise e suporte a DAGs, incluindo falhas e reprocessamentos.

- MongoDB: consulta, análise e suporte a bases NoSQL.

- Experiência com metodologias ágeis.


Requisitos Técnicos — Desejáveis:

- Experiência prévia com Open Finance.

- Conhecimento ou experiência com DBT.

- Requisitos Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

- Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes críticos.

- Comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e não técnicas.

- Proatividade e forte senso de ownership.

- Organização, disciplina e foco em documentação.


Modelo de Trabalho e Contratação

- Contratação: PJ

- Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Benefícios ATRA:

- TotalPass

- Reembolso 100% em certificações

- Parcerias educacionais

- Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas

- Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta


Sobre a ATRA:

Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas.

  • Atuar proativamente para prevenir churn com base em dados, comportamento de uso e sinais de risco.

Relacionamento Consultivo

  • Ser a principal referência do cliente dentro da Knewin, traduzindo necessidades em soluções;
  • Facilitar a adoção de produtos e orientar sobre melhores práticas;
  • Conduzir rituais executivos (QBRs/EBRs), apresentando resultados e roadmap de evolução.

Operação & Execução

  • Acompanhar métricas-chave como NRR, GRR, churn, engajamento e Earned Growth (NPS+);
  • Registrar interações, status e oportunidades no CRM com precisão e disciplina;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Produtos, Suporte, Dados e Comercial para resolução de problemas, ativação de melhorias e identificação de oportunidades.

Cultura de Cliente

  • Capacidade de realizar gestão de carteira com organização, priorização e disciplina;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e orientada a solução;

description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


About This Opportunity

As a Product Owner, you will work closely with both our Business Intelligence and Reporting Teams. In this position you will be accountable to manage data and reporting requirements to fulfill stakeholder or customer requests. You will also lead the roadmap and requirements analysis primarily for our financial systems.

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!



About The Role


Strong financial analysis and forecasting enables Teachable to determine how best to deploy our resources to continue (and accelerate) our growth. The FP&A team oversees the company's financial well-being while supporting operational and business planning in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. We work hard to ensure growth is accurately projected and that our financial results are properly accounted for.

We’re looking for an Senior FP&A Analyst who can help assess the opportunities ahead of us and support all areas of FP&A. This position will be heavily involved in various finance needs of the company, such as data analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling. If you enjoy the challenge of transforming business questions into financial models, please consider joining our team!


Key Responsibilities


  • Own updating and forecasting of Teachable Monthly P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow statements.
  • Put together monthly reporting powerpoint presentations.
  • Own all aspects of SG&A expense, tracking, and reporting internationally for Teachable.
  • Provide full visibility and tracking of company unit economics, and help the business drive operational efficiencies. This includes working closely with cross-functional partners to set targets and monitor performance such as LTV/CAC.
  • Support the finance department with ongoing analysis and forecasting for individual products and the overall company.
  • As needed, work on a variety of ad hoc and special projects that may include product or feature launches, pricing changes, or assessing the viability of new opportunities.


Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree, preferred concentration in finance, accounting, management or related fields .
  • 4+ years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, or investment banking.
  • Advanced Excel Skills such as Power Query
  • Proficient financial, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • BI tooling (Sigma, PowerBI) and SAP experience a plus.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple projects and a willingness to learn.
  • Eagerness to learn and make a meaningful contribution.
  • Excitement to work independently and chart your own course, while knowing when to seek guidance.
  • Fluent english is required.

title: Snowflake Data Engineer
description:
Overview

A US-based financial services organization is seeking an experienced Snowflake Data Engineer to support the ongoing development and optimization of its cloud data platform. This role will focus on building and maintaining scalable ETL pipelines, enforcing strong data governance practices, and preparing the enterprise data warehouse to leverage advanced capabilities such as Snowflake Cortex and Snowflake Intelligence.


This is a hands-on engineering role working closely with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to ensure high-quality, secure, and analytics-ready data.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines within Snowflake to support analytics and downstream use cases
  • Develop and maintain scalable data models to support reporting, BI, and advanced AI/ML workloads
  • Implement and enforce data governance best practices, including data quality, lineage, access controls, and compliance requirements
  • Prepare and structure data to enable future adoption of Snowflake Cortex and Snowflake Intelligence capabilities
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Monitor and improve performance, cost efficiency, and reliability of the Snowflake data warehouse
  • Support documentation and knowledge sharing across the data engineering function


Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience as a Data Engineer working with Snowflake in production environments
  • Proven experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines at scale
  • Solid understanding of data governance, data quality frameworks, and security best practices
  • Experience working in regulated or financial services environments is strongly preferred
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with cloud-based data warehouses


Preferred / Advantageous Skills

  • Experience with modern data tools such as:
  • dbt
  • Fivetran
  • Matillion
  • Apache Airflow
  • Experience collaborating with data science or AI teams

title: Engenheiro de dados SR
description:
A Stone:

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.


Como é ser um Egenheiro de Dados:

O Engenheiro de Dados será responsável por construir, implantar e otimizar pipelines de dados confiáveis e escaláveis, garantindo que os dados brutos sejam transformados em informações úteis e acessíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e segmentação de jornadas no contexto de CRM. O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analistas de negócios e equipes de TI para suportar diversas iniciativas orientadas por dados.


As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver fluxos automatizados e confiáveis para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de diversas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a qualidade e a integridade dos dados, identificando e corrigindo falhas na estrutura para evitar comprometimento das análises e jornadas.
  • Otimizar performance: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e implementar melhorias para garantir o processamento rápido e eficiente de consultas e análises.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em SQL (Procedures, DML, DDL, Pipelines) & Python.
  • Plataformas de Nuvem: Experiência com serviços de nuvem (GCP, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para armazenamento e processamento de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow e Cloud Functions.
  • Engenharia de Software: Conhecimento em boas práticas de codificação, versionamento (Git) e testes.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas e Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade analítica para identificar gargalos, depurar sistemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes de forma proativa.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Clareza para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos (como times de negócios e gestão), e vice-versa, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e resultados.
  • Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração: Atuar de forma integrada com engenheiros de dados, analistas e outras equipes, contribuindo para um ambiente produtivo e sinérgico.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em entregar soluções de dados que gerem valor real para o negócio e impulsionam a tomada de decisões.


Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 Segunda à sexta - de 08h às 17h ou de 09h às 18h.


Modelo/Local de trabalho:

  • Remoto


Etapas do Processo Seletivo

✍Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Case/ Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

✅Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.


Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
