title: Data Platform Architect (Remote)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Data Platform Architect with 8+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing and building secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouses, and embedded analytics ecosystems.

The Data Platform Architect is responsible for defining, implementing, and evolving the end-to-end data architecture that powers our platform analytics, reporting, and data automation ecosystem. This role will design a scalable, automated multi-tenant data warehouse and pipeline architecture that integrates hundreds of tenant schemas from our SaaS platform into a centralized, governed, and cost-optimized analytics environment (AWS-based: Redshift, S3, Glue, Lake Formation, QuickSight).The ideal candidate combines deep data engineering expertise with systems-level architecture—balancing automation, performance, and cost while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and scalability for every customer.Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities


Architecture & Design

  • Architect a multi-tenant data platform capable of ingesting 500+ tenant schemas with automated onboarding/offboarding workflows
  • Design an end-to-end architecture that includes data lakes, warehouses, transformation pipelines, and semantic layers
  • Define data zone strategy (Raw Staging Serving), partitioning, and schema evolution patterns
  • Establish standards for data contracts, metadata cataloging, and lineage tracking across all tenants
  • Drive selection and configuration of core technologies (e.g., Redshift, Glue, S3, Lake Formation, dbt, Lambda, Airflow)
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps to ensure infrastructure as code (IaC) is applied to all data assets


Pipeline & Automation

  • Design metadata-driven ingestion and transformation pipelines supporting incremental updates, schema drift, and tenant isolation
  • Ensure pipelines are idempotent, self-healing, and fully integrated into CI/CD processes
  • Partner with the Data Pipeline Engineers to deliver automated data onboarding, testing, and quality validation


Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Define workload management, clustering, and distribution strategies in Redshift or equivalent MPP systems
  • Implement data lifecycle management policies to optimize storage and compute costs
  • Continuously evaluate query performance, caching, and concurrency scaling options


Governance & Security

  • Implement data governance frameworks to ensure privacy, PII compliance, and secure tenant isolation
  • Partner with InfoSec to align encryption (KMS multi-region keys), object lock, and access control policies with SOC/PCI/GDPR standards
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and anomaly detection systems for data quality and operational stability


Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to ensure architecture aligns with business and product goals
  • Mentor engineers on modern data platform practices (dbt, ELT, IaC, observability)
  • Act as a technical authority and evangelist for data platform best practices within the organization


Required Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including at least 3 years architecting cloud-native data platforms
  • Proven success in building and maintaining large-scale data pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, or Airflow
  • Expertise in Redshift, Snowflake, or equivalent MPP databases, including workload management and query optimization
  • Proficiency with S3-based data lakes, Glue Data Catalog, and Lake Formation
  • Deep understanding of data modeling (Kimball/ELT) and multi-tenant system design
  • Experience defining and enforcing data governance frameworks (PII, access control, lineage)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data assets
  • Strong SQL and Python skills; dbt experience preferred
  • Familiarity with embedded BI/analytics tools (QuickSight, GoodData) and semantic layer concepts


Desired Experience

  • Experience with schema-per-tenant architectures and automated tenant provisioning
  • Familiarity with Auth0 / SSO integration for analytics tools (e.g., QuickSight embedding)
  • Experience implementing observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, CloudWatch, Monte Carlo, Soda Core)
  • Exposure to data mesh or domain-oriented design principles
  • Prior experience in hospitality / property-management SaaS product ecosystems


Additional Information

  • When you know your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Engenheiro de Dados Especialista
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Liderar a definição técnica e a evolução da estratégia de Data Lake, garantindo uma arquitetura robusta e escalável;
  • Desenhar e estruturar camadas de dados (Raw, Trusted, Refined) e fluxos de processamento baseados em padrões de ETL e ELT;
  • Estabelecer diretrizes para que a arquitetura suporte o crescimento de volume e complexidade da companhia;
  • Desenvolver e automatizar pipelines de dados complexos, garantindo a entrega eficiente para modelos preditivos e análises avançadas;
  • Otimizar continuamente o desempenho dos fluxos de dados, reduzindo latência e custos operacionais de processamento;
  • Implementar ferramentas e práticas que permitam a escalabilidade da modelagem de dados voltada à decisão estratégica;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida da aquisição de dados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para os stakeholders;
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados, estabelecendo processos de monitoramento e validação;
  • Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e as áreas de negócio, garantindo que as soluções de dados estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Tecnologia.
  • Sólida experiência em pipelines e Big Data (Python/Java/Scala);
  • Vivência em liderança de equipes e metodologias ágeis;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Perfil autônomo, analítico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.


Nossos benefícios:


O Que Temos Para Você

title: Product Owner
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


About This Opportunity

As a Product Owner, you will work closely with both our Business Intelligence and Reporting Teams. In this position you will be accountable to manage data and reporting requirements to fulfill stakeholder or customer requests. You will also lead the roadmap and requirements analysis primarily for our financial systems.


The ideal candidate will have experience with Scrum/ Agile processes, Accounting/Financial Systems, SSRS, PowerBI, and Tableau. Knowledge of ETL and Oracle/Oracle EBS is a plus.


Professional English Language skills are required.


Position is CLT and fully remote (must reside in Brazil). Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for Internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!



Responsibilities

  • Work directly with Finance & Accounting leadership and BI teams on product backlog and coordinate with various technology teams across InComm to implement new solutions.
  • Build, manage and prioritize product backlog based on the overall strategy and business objectives for future product development.
  • Responsible for creating and/or managing following artifacts:

-Road Map

-Development Backlog

-User Stories and Sprint Tasks

-Supporting documents for user stories


  • Monitor and Review ServiceNow (SNOW) requests
  • Create product vision and roadmap which accomplishes the goal of the vision and convey that vision to the scrum team.
  • Ensure user stories are well defined and ready for development to begin.
  • Responsible for optimizing the value of the work done.
  • Accountable for each stage of the development process and the final product.
  • Ensure close collaboration with development team. Be available to address any questions team members have regarding requirements or implementation of a product feature.
  • Responsible for communicating with stakeholders across the board, including product managers, leadership, customers, and the development team to make sure their vision is aligned with business objectives.


Preferred Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experience with reporting and operations within Billing, Accounting, and Sales
  • Experience working in Agile/Technical environments
  • Skilled in and comfortable working alongside technical stakeholders, translating business needs into clear, actionable inputs for development or support teams.
  • Proficient in Agile/Scrum
  • Agile/Scrum Certification
  • General knowledge of ERP, Databases (Oracle & MS SQL) and DataLakesis a plus
  • SRS, PowerBI, and Tableau and knowledge of ETL.


InComm provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin, citizenship, veteran’s status, age, disability status, genetics or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Graphic Designer (CPG Industry Focus)
description:
Job Title: Graphic Designer (CPG Industry Focus)


About the Role

We’re looking for a Graphic Designer to support ongoing creative production across digital channels. This is an execution-heavy role focused on producing high-quality still images (80% graphic designs for social media and UXUI), motion graphics (10-20% of time), and video edits (10-20% of time) that align with established brand guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

  • Create still graphic assets for digital channels (social, web, ads, email)
  • Design and animate motion graphics and GIFs from scratch
  • Edit short-form and mid-length videos in line with brand guidelines
  • Adapt and resize assets for multiple formats and platforms
  • Maintain visual consistency across all deliverables
  • Organize and manage design files for efficient collaboration
  • Implement feedback efficiently while meeting deadlines

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong proficiency in Figma or equivalent vector design tools
  • Experience creating still images, motion graphics, and GIFs
  • Solid video editing skills (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or equivalent)
  • Strong understanding of layout, typography, color, and brand consistency
  • Ability to work independently with clear direction and guidelines
  • Experience producing assets for digital and marketing use cases

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Ability to create 3D renders (Blender, Cinema 4D, or similar) - Packging Design
  • Experience with After Effects for motion design
  • Familiarity with social-first and performance-driven creatives

Role Details

  • Type: Part-time (20 hours per week)
  • Location: Fully remote
  • Schedule: Flexible, with some overlap with client working hours preferred
  • Compensation: Based on experience and skill level


Portfolio Requirements

Candidates should share a portfolio demonstrating:

  • Still graphic design
  • Motion graphics / GIFs
  • Video editing samples
  • (3D work, if available, is a strong plus)

description:

  • Experiência prática em gerenciamento e carga de dados utilizando Data Loader ou Workbench.


Desejáveis:

  • Certificações Salesforce.

  • Desenvolver e liderar soluções técnicas na plataforma Salesforce, utilizando Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC) e recursos declarativos;
  • Atuar desde a análise de requisitos até a entrega em produção, garantindo alta performance, escalabilidade e aderência às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento;

Somos um escritório contratado do banco BTG Pactual, o maior banco de Investimentos da América Latina!


Somos focados em trazer proximidade e personalização de serviços, sempre visando melhor atender os objetivos financeiros dos nossos clientes.


Como parte dos nossos planos de expansão, estamos em busca de novos Assessores de Investimentos em todo o território nacional.


Nossa cultura organizacional valoriza a autonomia, o acompanhamento e a flexibilidade para os vinculados.


Oferecemos um modelo de trabalho completamente remoto, utilizando a tecnologia a nosso favor, a fim de promover agilidade, acessibilidade e qualidade de vida para todos os envolvidos em nossos planos de negócios!


Somos intrinsecamente vinculados ao campo da Educação, com parcerias importantes neste setor, a fim de promover aprimoramento crescente de nossos serviços e da carreira dos nossos associados.


Aqui você irá encontrar um ambiente leve e colaborativo, pois acreditamos que é esta a ética de trabalho que nos leva a qualidade e excelência em serviços financeiros!




Sobre o Cargo


  • Ofertar assessoria de investimentos personalizada, com foco na confiança e assertividade;
  • Oferecer serviços, estratégias e os melhores caminhos para atender as necessidades especificas de cada cliente;

  • Realizar análises assertivas e contextualizadas com perfil do investidor;

  • Ter conhecimentos sobre Mercado Financeiro, Investimentos e desejo de se aprimorar;
  • Ter interesses e habilidades comerciais;

  • Desejar um modelo de trabalho remoto, alinhado com uma visão de negócios e identidade organizacional moderna e digital;
  • Motivação de crescer e alavancar ganhos!
  • Ser autônomo, movido por desafios e capaz de colaborar para objetivos comuns!
  • Possuir excelentes habilidades comunicacionais.



Modelo de Contratação


  • O assessor se vincula ao escritório no modelo de sociedade;
  • É articulado um percentual de repasses competitivo, passível de evolução e pensado de acordo com a bagagem do assessor;
  • Apoio no processo de transição de carreira e de entrada no mercado, contanto com acompanhamento próximo e valor de suporte (mínimo garantido mensal) com duração de 6 meses.



Etapas de Seleção

  • Processo de Compliance.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. Our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.


Who are You ?


You are relentlessly committed to delivering exceptional partner support, combining deep technical knowledge with sharp analytical skills to resolve issues efficiently and prevent them from recurring. You excel at interpreting data, logs, and system behavior to uncover root causes and provide clear, actionable insights to both partners and internal teams.


A confident and influential communicator, you build strong relationships with operators, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. You thrive on translating complex technical details into understandable guidance, ensuring that partners always feel supported and informed.


Where you Fit In:


We are seeking a proactive and technically strong B2B Technical Support Specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you will leverage your deep understanding of the iGaming industry and your strong analytical mindset to troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve issues reported by our operators and internal stakeholders.


Working closely with the ITSM department — and reporting directly to the Technical Support Team Lead — you will be a key player in ensuring high-quality, timely support. Your ability to interpret logs, analyze platform behavior, communicate clearly, and escalate effectively will help maintain platform reliability and deliver an exceptional partner experience.


You will thrive in a fast-paced environment where attention to detail, technical curiosity, and a commitment to service excellence are essential. Your work will be pivotal in strengthening partner trust, improving operational stability, and supporting our mission to deliver a seamless and compliant gaming experience worldwide.


The impact you will have:


  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for B2B operators, platform partners, and integrators, ensuring their issues are resolved quickly, accurately, and with minimal business impact.
  • Perform in-depth technical troubleshooting across game integrations, wallet systems, API calls, transaction flows, and platform services — using logs, monitoring tools, and diagnostics to identify root causes.
  • Identify, flag, and track repetitive issues or recurring error patterns, escalating them with clear technical context to drive permanent fixes.
  • Ensure all partner interactions, escalations, and resolutions align with regulatory requirements, internal controls, and jurisdictional rules — maintaining strong compliance awareness at all times.
  • Coordinate cross-team escalations ensuring that complex issues are escalated and documented clearly and progressed efficiently.
  • Stay current with industry standards, emerging technologies, and best practices across iGaming, payments, and platform operations, recommending improvements to processes and tooling.
  • Champion adoption of shared support frameworks — authoring playbooks, SLA policies, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles to standardize excellence across the organization.


What we’re looking for:


  • Experience in B2B Technical Support within the Casino or iGaming sector.
  • Strong understanding of iGaming systems such as game aggregation, wallet services, RNG, bonus engines, player tracking, and jurisdictional compliance.
  • Experience working with logs, monitoring tools, and debugging complex integration issues.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cases, partners, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent English communication and presentation skills.
  • Hands-on experience with common support tooling (ex: Jira, Grafana, Kibana, etc.).


This role is remote and based in Brazil.


Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with 30 years of experience, is seeking a Salesforce OEM Application Developer to support a US-based customer. This position collaborates with development teams in the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, focusing on designing, developing, and maintaining a managed Salesforce OEM application.


This role is ideal for someone with deep Salesforce development expertise, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly in English.


About the Role:


As a Salesforce OEM Application Developer, you will work closely with product managers, clients, and internal teams to gather and refine technical requirements, translate business needs into robust application features, and maintain a secure, scalable Salesforce OEM solution. You will develop advanced functionality combining code and configuration, manage integrations and data migrations, troubleshoot application-level issues, and support packaging, versioning, and upgrades of the managed application.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and maintain a managed Salesforce OEM application using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tools.
  • Build advanced Salesforce functionality, including complex Flows, triggers, asynchronous processing, and Community/Experience Cloud implementations .
  • Architect scalable and secure solutions aligned with Salesforce OEM/ISV best practices , including multi-tenant considerations and upgrade-safe design.
  • Develop and maintain custom data models, integrations, and automation , ensuring performance, governor-limit compliance, and maintainability.
  • Manage data migration and transformation processes using Apex, ETL tools, and Salesforce APIs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application-level issues including Apex logic, automation conflicts, and deployment errors.
  • Build test classes with strong code coverage and participate in CI/CD and release management activities.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation , including architecture workbooks, developer/admin guides, testing strategies, and deployment protocols.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Administrators and customer technical teams to ensure correct configuration and extension of the OEM application.


Required Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on Salesforce development experience , including Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Proven experience blending programmatic development and declarative configuration for scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Experience designing and implementing advanced Flows, triggers, and automation based on business rules.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, security, permissions, sharing models, and performance optimization .
  • Experience collaborating with stakeholders to design sophisticated user experiences across screens, records, and automation processes.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and modern release practices .
  • Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I/II, Administrator or Advanced Administrator (Platform App Builder preferred).
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills in English.
  • Familiarity with C# and the .NET ecosystem for backend services or integrations.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AI-assisted development workflows for code generation, testing, or documentation.
  • Prior experience building or supporting OEM/ISV applications , including managed packages, AppExchange distribution, or Salesforce Security Review preparation.
  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.

title: GenAI Solution Architect
description:
GenAI Solution Architect

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Full Time


In this role, you will:

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.


Technical Expertise:

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI/CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP/REST) and API development.


  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.


Specialized Skills:

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.


Soft Skills and Others:

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

  • dbt

  • Apache Airflow
  • Experience collaborating with data science or AI teams

title: Cloud Engineer - Kubernetes (Home Office)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Kubernetes Engineer to work remotely for one of our clients. This is a role with a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries.


Job location: Remote, work anywhere from Brazil.


This job requires excellent English, written and spoken. Please submit a resume in English and be prepared for English language interviews throughout the process.


The Kubernetes Engineer plays a critical role in designing, building, operating, and securing our client's container platforms, with a focus on Kubernetes-based PaaS (Platform as a Service) environments. This role ensures high availability, performance, security, and lifecycle management of Kubernetes platforms across Lab, Non-Prod, and Production environments. The Kubernetes Engineer works cross‑functionally with cloud, cybersecurity, compute, network, and application teams to deliver resilient and automated platform services aligned with Product Management and CCOE strategies


Key Responsibilities :

Platform Engineering & Operations

  • Design, build, and operate Kubernetes clusters (on‑prem and/or cloud) following standard reference architectures.
  • Implement and maintain Kubernetes add‑ons, CSI storage drivers, CNI network plugins, and ingress controllers.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and reliability of Kubernetes clusters and workloads.
  • Perform lifecycle upgrades of Kubernetes, OS, infrastructure software (GKE, Rancher), and supporting components.
  • Manage persistent storage solutions including migration to Dell CSI‑enabled PowerStore and Portworx.
  • Manage hardware lifecycle work for Kubernetes‑backed compute environments.

Security, Compliance & Cybersecurity Alignment

  • Implement and maintain vulnerability remediation workflows to achieve >90% SecureLens compliance.
  • Enable PAM authentication across Kubernetes and supporting OS layers.
  • Ensure clusters and workloads meet cybersecurity, data privacy, and lifecycle compliance requirements.
  • Support audits and remediate non‑compliant configurations.
  • Drive the transition from CentOS to supported and approved OS platforms.

Automation, Standardization & Continuous Improvement

  • Automate repetitive operational tasks, cluster provisioning, workload deployment, configuration, and compliance enforcement.
  • Contribute to product roadmaps, automation frameworks, and standard reference designs.
  • Participate in EPIC initiatives to reduce complexity and increase efficiency.
  • Assist with PPDM migrations for Kubernetes‑based backup workloads.
  • Contribute to patch testing frameworks using canary/ring deployment models.

Platform 3 / CCOE Collaboration & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with CCOE intake, design, and fulfillment teams to deliver frictionless onboarding.
  • Ensure Kubernetes solutions align with lifecycle, security, and platform standards.
  • Conduct workshops and training sessions to extend platform knowledge across Cox.
  • Participate in customer feedback loops, roadshows, and product management routines.
  • Provide timely support for Rancher migrations and eventual decommissioning.

AI & GPU Platform Support

  • Support deployment of GPU‑enabled Kubernetes clusters.
  • Implement automation for provisioning GPU workloads.
  • Validate ServiceNow intake workflows for AI-native tenant designs.

Observability, Reporting & KPIs

  • Enhance New Relic dashboards for Kubernetes reliability and health.
  • Develop and publish right-sizing audit reports for cluster optimization and cost efficiency.
  • Track cluster capacity, growth, and licensing/tool usage.
  • Participate in monthly operational reviews.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*

title: Brand Designer Pleno
description:
Cód.57182


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Designer, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Domínio das ferramentas Adobe: Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects e Premiere.
  • Experiência prévia em design gráfico/motion, preferencialmente em áreas de marketing ou comunicação interna.
  • Capacidade de aplicar e desdobrar identidade visual da marca em diferentes pontos de contato e materiais.
  • Experiência na produção de vídeos, motions, apresentações institucionais e comerciais.
  • Habilidade para conduzir demandas de design de ponta a ponta (criação, adaptação, desdobramento visual e entrega), alinhando-se às diretrizes da marca e aos objetivos de marketing e endomarketing.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Preferred

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Lead Software Engineer to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Brazil - Remote

Industry: IT & Services.


This position requires advanced communication skills in English, both written and verbal.


Lead Software Engineer | About You

As a Lead Software Engineer, you are responsible for driving the technical vision behind scalable, modern applications while guiding a high‑performing engineering team. You’re someone who thrives at the intersection of architecture, hands‑on development, and mentorship, balancing strategic decision‑making with a passion for building exceptional software. You enjoy shaping engineering standards, elevating team capabilities, and making thoughtful choices that influence long-term product success. You’re motivated by solving complex technical challenges and creating environments where engineers can do their best work.


Lead Software Engineer | Day-to-Day

  • Lead the design and development of complex, scalable applications using .NET and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular or React.
  • Define engineering standards, best practices, and architectural guidelines for the development team.
  • Architect and maintain secure, high‑availability cloud-based systems optimized for performance.
  • Partner with Product, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure alignment between technical solutions and business goals.
  • Mentor engineers, fostering continuous learning, quality craftsmanship, and knowledge sharing.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to quality, security, and maintainability standards.
  • Solve advanced technical challenges and influence decisions related to architecture and technology stack selection.


Lead Software Engineer | Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with advanced proficiency in .NET and modern JavaScript frameworks (Angular or React).
  • Proven experience leading engineering teams and collaborating effectively across functions.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy

  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.

Required Experience

  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team

description:
Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. Strong financial analysis and forecasting enables Teachable to determine how best to deploy our resources to continue (and accelerate) our growth. title: Cloud Engineer - Kubernetes (Home Office)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Kubernetes Engineer to work remotely for one of our clients. This is a role with a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries.


Job location: Remote, work anywhere from Brazil.


This job requires excellent English, written and spoken. Please submit a resume in English and be prepared for English language interviews throughout the process.


The Kubernetes Engineer plays a critical role in designing, building, operating, and securing our client's container platforms, with a focus on Kubernetes-based PaaS (Platform as a Service) environments. This role ensures high availability, performance, security, and lifecycle management of Kubernetes platforms across Lab, Non-Prod, and Production environments. The Kubernetes Engineer works cross‑functionally with cloud, cybersecurity, compute, network, and application teams to deliver resilient and automated platform services aligned with Product Management and CCOE strategies


Key Responsibilities :

Platform Engineering & Operations

  • Design, build, and operate Kubernetes clusters (on‑prem and/or cloud) following standard reference architectures.
  • Implement and maintain Kubernetes add‑ons, CSI storage drivers, CNI network plugins, and ingress controllers.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and reliability of Kubernetes clusters and workloads.
  • Perform lifecycle upgrades of Kubernetes, OS, infrastructure software (GKE, Rancher), and supporting components.
  • Manage persistent storage solutions including migration to Dell CSI‑enabled PowerStore and Portworx.
  • Manage hardware lifecycle work for Kubernetes‑backed compute environments.

Security, Compliance & Cybersecurity Alignment

  • Implement and maintain vulnerability remediation workflows to achieve >90% SecureLens compliance.
  • Enable PAM authentication across Kubernetes and supporting OS layers.
  • Ensure clusters and workloads meet cybersecurity, data privacy, and lifecycle compliance requirements.
  • Support audits and remediate non‑compliant configurations.
  • Drive the transition from CentOS to supported and approved OS platforms.

Automation, Standardization & Continuous Improvement

  • Automate repetitive operational tasks, cluster provisioning, workload deployment, configuration, and compliance enforcement.
  • Contribute to product roadmaps, automation frameworks, and standard reference designs.
  • Participate in EPIC initiatives to reduce complexity and increase efficiency.
  • Assist with PPDM migrations for Kubernetes‑based backup workloads.
  • Contribute to patch testing frameworks using canary/ring deployment models.

Platform 3 / CCOE Collaboration & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with CCOE intake, design, and fulfillment teams to deliver frictionless onboarding.
  • Ensure Kubernetes solutions align with lifecycle, security, and platform standards.
  • Conduct workshops and training sessions to extend platform knowledge across Cox.
  • Participate in customer feedback loops, roadshows, and product management routines.
  • Provide timely support for Rancher migrations and eventual decommissioning.

AI & GPU Platform Support

  • Support deployment of GPU‑enabled Kubernetes clusters.
  • Implement automation for provisioning GPU workloads.
  • Validate ServiceNow intake workflows for AI-native tenant designs.

Observability, Reporting & KPIs

  • Enhance New Relic dashboards for Kubernetes reliability and health.
  • Develop and publish right-sizing audit reports for cluster optimization and cost efficiency.
  • Track cluster capacity, growth, and licensing/tool usage.
  • Participate in monthly operational reviews.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.


Additional Information

title: Tech Lead
description:
Estamos em busca de um Tech Lead para se juntar à nossa jornada na DataCube!

Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, arquitetura, APIs e gosta de atuar com a mão na massa, ao mesmo tempo em que lidera pessoas e influencia decisões estratégicas, essa vaga é para você.


Aqui, você vai atuar com alto nível técnico, liderar um time de desenvolvedores e ser peça-chave na evolução da nossa plataforma. Buscamos alguém que una excelência técnica + liderança + visão de produto.


Sua missão será:

Ser responsável pelo desenvolvimento, evolução e sustentação das APIs internas e externas da DataCube, garantindo alta performance, segurança, escalabilidade e qualidade, além de liderar a equipe de desenvolvedores com foco em entrega, excelência técnica e gestão de pessoas.


Você vai ficar responsável por:

  • Projetar, desenvolver, manter e evoluir APIs internas e externas da plataforma;
  • Realizar a gestão da equipe de desenvolvedores, garantindo direcionamento técnico, qualidade das entregas e evolução profissional;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar a evolução técnica e comportamental do time;
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade, segurança e confiabilidade das integrações;
  • Definir e aplicar padrões de arquitetura, design de APIs, versionamento, autenticação e autorização;
  • Conduzir code reviews técnicos, assegurando qualidade, legibilidade e manutenibilidade;
  • Analisar gargalos de performance, latência e consumo de recursos, propondo soluções de otimização;
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, garantindo modelagem eficiente e integridade dos dados;
  • Implementar e manter mecanismos de observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing);
  • Participar da definição de roadmap técnico, evolução de arquitetura e decisões estruturais da plataforma;
  • Garantir aderência às boas práticas de segurança (OWASP, autenticação, controle de acesso, proteção de dados);
  • Documentar APIs, fluxos de integração e decisões arquiteturais;
  • Propor e implementar melhorias preventivas para reduzir riscos e débitos técnicos.


Competências Técnicas:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento com PHP, Node.js, Java, Python.
  • Domínio no desenvolvimento e manutenção de APIs RESTful;
  • Conhecimento avançado em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Experiência com arquiteturas escaláveis e distribuídas;
  • Forte conhecimento em Git e fluxo de trabalho colaborativo;
  • Experiência em análise de performance, profiling e otimização de sistemas;
  • Vivência com boas práticas de segurança de aplicações e APIs;
  • Capacidade de desenhar soluções técnicas complexas e sustentar decisões arquiteturais.


Competências Comportamentais:

  • Perfil analítico e crítico, com forte capacidade de diagnóstico e resolução de problemas;
  • Autonomia técnica para conduzir soluções ponta a ponta;
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva para interagir com time, produto e stakeholders;
  • Organização e disciplina para lidar com múltiplas demandas;
  • Proatividade na identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Visão sistêmica para entender impactos no produto, negócio e experiência do usuário;
  • Capacidade de liderar, orientar e desenvolver pessoas com maturidade e responsabilidade;
  • Postura de liderança pelo exemplo, com forte senso de ética e responsabilidade.


O que oferecemos para garantir sua qualidade de vida e crescimento profissional:

  • 100% remoto – Trabalhe de onde se sentir mais confortável;
  • Modelo de contratação PJ – com todo suporte e assessoria necessária;
  • Sessões de terapia gratuitas – acesso ao nosso psicólogo para seu bem-estar;
  • Day Off de aniversário – seu dia especial é só seu;
  • Equipamentos de trabalho – tudo o que você precisa para performar bem;
  • Suporte educacional – investimos no seu desenvolvimento com cursos e capacitações;
  • Bônus anual – reconhecimento pelo seu esforço e contribuição.


Essa é apenas uma parte de quem somos e do que proporcionamos para você! Se interessou? Você também pode enviar o seu currículo para

title: Senior Applied Scientist
description:
Senior Applied Scientist (Remote – Brazil)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Location: Remote (Brazil) – São Paulo

Duration: Open-Ended


Job Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Applied Scientist to lead the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning solutions. In this role, you will influence the technical direction of the team, collaborate closely with Product and Engineering partners, and drive innovation across data-driven initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who combines strong technical expertise with leadership capabilities and a passion for building high-impact solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end development and deployment of Machine Learning models to solve complex business problems.
  • Write and maintain clean, efficient, scalable code following industry best practices.
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and support data-informed decision-making.
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies, including deep learning and modern frameworks, to build robust models.
  • Take ownership of key system components and influence the broader technical strategy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to design deployable, production-ready ML solutions.
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, fostering team expertise and growth.
  • Contribute to organizational technical leadership through patent filings and publications in top-tier venues.


Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning.
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML and deep learning models in production at scale.
  • Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, pipelines, feature engineering, experiment design).
  • Strong knowledge of algorithms and techniques such as gradient boosting, deep neural networks, transformers, and optimization methods.
  • Experience in Computer Vision ; experience in Causal Inference is highly desirable.
  • Expertise with Python scientific libraries (NumPy, pandas, Polars) and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-Learn).
  • Strong data engineering skills and comfort working with large-scale datasets.
  • Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark).
  • Experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Fluency in Python and SQL .


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related fields.
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail industry problems.
  • Familiarity with modern MLOps tools and pipelines .
  • Impact-driven mindset and commitment to delivering high-quality models.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities with experience guiding or managing technical teams.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
O que você fará:

Projetar e desenvolver arquiteturas de dados que suportem indicadores estratégicos, metas e engajamento.

Construir e automatizar pipelines ETL/ELT integrando sistemas transacionais e analíticos.

Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados analíticos (Star Schema e Snowflake).

Escrever e otimizar SQL avançado (CTEs, funções de janela, ajuste de desempenho).

Implementar processamento e automação de dados usando Python.

Construir e manter plataformas de dados baseadas em nuvem na AWS

Trabalhar com Amazon S3, Redshift e/ou Athena para dar suporte ao armazenamento e análise de dados

Aplicar a qualidade, governança e linhagem dos dados em todos os conjuntos de dados

Colaborar com as partes interessadas do negócio para traduzir as necessidades do negócio em conjuntos de dados analíticos

Dar suporte a ferramentas de BI e análise, como Power BI, Tableau e Looker

Garantir a conformidade com os requisitos regulatórios e de governança em ambientes bancários e de fintech

Requisitos Mandatários:

Sólida experiência como engenheiro de dados.

Solida experiencia com SQL (CTEs, funções de janela, otimização de desempenho).

Experiência com modelagem analítica de dados.

Experiência prática na construção e automação de pipelines ETL/ELT.

Fortes habilidades em Python para processamento de dados e automação.

Sólida experiência com arquiteturas de dados em nuvem na AWS.

Experiência prática com Amazon S3 e Redshift e/ou Athena.

Experiência na integração de sistemas transacionais e analíticos.

Sólida experiência em armazenamento de dados e data lakes.

Experiência no uso do Git para controle de versão de código.

Sólido conhecimento de qualidade, governança e linhagem de dados.

Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em conjuntos de dados analíticos confiáveis.

Experiência com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker).

Experiência anterior em ambientes regulamentados (bancos, fintechs, LGPD).

Diferenciais:

Experiência com dbt.

Uso de ferramentas de orquestração, como Airflow, Prefect ou Dagster.

Conhecimento de AWS Glue. Experiencia com IA.

Familiaridade com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform).

Conhecimento de arquiteturas Lakehouse ou Data Mesh.

Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).

title: Estágio em tecnologia
description:
Sobre nós - Okiar Intelligence

A Okiar é uma empresa inovadora e dinâmica que atua no mercado de dados, consumer insights e inteligência de mercado. Somos flexíveis, pensamos diferente e focamos no negócio. Atendemos hoje empresas como Nubank, Amex, Sallve, Sicredi e Farmax. Nós somos diferentes de uma consultoria, somos parceiros de inteligência.


Descrição da Vaga

title: Azure Windows Solutions Architect
description:
Lead Azure & Windows Infrastructure Architect (POD 1 & 2)

Location: Remote / Hybrid | Experience: 13+ Years | Level: C5/C6 (Senior Leadership)

The Challenge

Are you a master of Windows ecosystems ready to lead the charge into the Cloud? We are looking for a Lead Infrastructure Architect to spearhead large-scale migrations for high-stakes industries like Banking, Healthcare, and Insurance.

In this role, you aren’t just a designer—you are the General of our Cloud PODs. You will lead a technical team of 5+ engineers, ensuring that complex legacy environments are modernized, secured, and migrated to Azure with surgical precision.

Your Impact

  • Architectural Sovereignty: Design the end-to-end \"Target State\" for massive enterprise environments. You will own the HLD (High-Level Design) and LLD (Low-Level Design) , ensuring every VM, Cluster, and Network packet has its place.
  • Lead the Squad: Act as the technical North Star for a team of 5+ infra experts. You will guide, govern, and mentor your team to deliver excellence under pressure.
  • Windows Modernization: You are the expert who knows Windows Clustering, DFS, and File/Print Services inside out. You’ll be the one to solve the \"impossible\" legacy issues during migration.
  • The Business Brain: You don't just build; you justify. You’ll use TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) and ROI metrics to prove to stakeholders that your architecture is the most efficient and cost-effective solution.
  • Mission Critical Support: You will oversee the stability of the environment, ensuring 24/7 reliability through robust Backup, DR, and Monitoring solutions.

What You Bring to the Table

  • The Veteran Background: 13+ years in IT with a deep focus on Windows Server and Azure IaaS/PaaS .
  • Migration Mastery: Expert-level experience with Azure Migrate for server consolidation and workload shifts.
  • Networking & Identity Guru: Deep knowledge of DNS, DHCP, WINS, and Azure IAM/Key Vault to keep our Landing Zones secure and connected.
  • Resilience Expert: Hands-on experience with Windows Clustering and Azure Site Recovery (ASR) for business continuity.
  • Strategic Communicator: You can navigate a 24x7 shift environment, manage customer calls with poise, and present complex solutions to C-suite stakeholders.

The Toolkit

  • Core: Azure Infrastructure, Windows Server (all versions), Azure Networking.
  • Leadership: Team Management & Technical Governance.
  • Compliance: Experience in regulated domains (SIAM, Data Privacy, Financial regulations).
  • Certifications (Preferred): AZ-305 (Solutions Architect Expert) or AZ-104 .

Why This Role?

This is more than a migration job; it’s a leadership opportunity. You will own the strategy for POD 1 and 2 , deciding how global enterprises evolve. If you enjoy solving complex \"under-the-hood\" Windows issues while simultaneously designing high-level cloud strategies, this is your next career move.

Ready to lead the migration? Apply now and let’s build the future of Enterprise Cloud.

What makes this version effective?

  • Directly addresses the \"POD\" structure: It makes the candidate feel like they are leading a specific mission.
  • Highlights the Hybrid nature: It acknowledges that they need to be good at both the new (Azure) and the old (Windows Clustering/DFS).
  • Emphasizes Leadership: By using words like \"General\" and \"North Star,\" you attract people who want to manage teams, not just configurations.

title: Analytics Architect – Azure Databricks / Fabric
description:
Analytics Architect – Azure Databricks / Microsoft Fabric


Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and Microsoft Fabric .
  • Partner closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams to translate requirements into scalable analytics platforms.
  • Own the end-to-end delivery of data solutions, ensuring adherence to architectural standards, security, governance and best practices.
  • Design, build and optimize data ingestion pipelines and ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Databricks, PySpark and Azure Data Factory .
  • Integrate Databricks with Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric and on-premise systems.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineering teams, promoting continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of architecture, data flows and operational processes.
  • Enforce best practices around code quality, performance optimization, scalability and data security.
  • Stay current with Databricks and Azure analytics advancements to continuously evolve the platform.


Essential Skills

  • Extensive hands-on experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebooks and Delta Lake .
  • Strong proficiency in PySpark , Spark and big data technologies (Hadoop ecosystem).
  • In-depth knowledge of Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory , Power BI, SSRS, SSAS and SKU transitions (PSKU to F SKU).
  • Expertise in building data lakes, data warehouses and large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Advanced SQL skills with familiarity in NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines , Git and modern DevOps practices.
  • Solid understanding of cloud security and governance principles.


Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to business stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to risk mitigation.
  • Proven leadership and mentoring capabilities.


Nice to Have

  • Advanced experience with Power BI for reporting and analytics.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration workloads.
  • Experience with Spark Streaming for real-time data processing.
  • Familiarity with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates and Infrastructure as Code practices.


Experience Requirements

  • 12+ years of experience building data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks, Synapse Notebooks and Azure Data Factory .
  • Hands-on expertise with Delta Tables, Delta Lake and ADLS Gen2 .
  • Experience using Auto Loader and Delta Live Tables for scalable data ingestion.
  • Proven ability to build and optimize query layers using Databricks SQL .
  • Demonstrated integration of Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2 and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions.
  • Prior experience designing, optimizing and deploying Power BI dashboards and reports .
  • Strong exposure to modern CI/CD frameworks within Databricks and cloud-native environments.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados SR - Sustentação Open Finance
description:
A ATRA está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados para atuar na sustentação, monitoramento e operação de um ambiente crítico de Open Finance em GCP , garantindo alta confiabilidade, estabilidade operacional e atendimento a requisitos regulatórios, operacionais e de segurança.


Descrição da vaga:

O projeto de Open Finance tem como objetivo garantir a ingestão, processamento, monitoramento e disponibilidade de dados financeiros em ambiente Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Devido à criticidade do ecossistema e à necessidade de alta confiabilidade dos pipelines de dados, o(a) profissional atuará diretamente na operação e sustentação do ambiente, assegurando rápida resposta a incidentes, estabilidade contínua e suporte às áreas envolvidas.


Responsabilidades:

O(a) profissional atuará de ponta a ponta na sustentação do ambiente, incluindo:

- Monitoramento contínuo de pipelines de dados (batch e on-demand).

- Atuação imediata em falhas operacionais e incidentes críticos.

- Análise de logs e troubleshooting em Dataproc, pipelines e DAGs.

- Acompanhamento de cargas, reprocessamentos e validações de dados.

- Interface com times de Engenharia, Arquitetura, Governança e Negócio.

- Apoio em processos de estabilização e melhoria contínua.

- Documentação de incidentes, análises de causa raiz e planos de ação.


Requisitos Técnicos Necessários:

- Experiência sólida com Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

- Domínio de BigQuery (modelagem, performance e gestão de custos).

- Experiência com Dataproc / Apache Spark.

- Vivência com pipelines batch e reprocessamentos.

- Análise de logs e falhas em pipelines de dados.

- Conhecimento em IAM e gestão de permissões.

- Experiência em ambientes críticos ou regulados.

- Continuous Query: processamento contínuo e atualização incremental de dados (streaming ou near real-time).

- Pub/Sub: integração e monitoramento de pipelines orientados a eventos.

- Cloud SQL (MySQL): operação, suporte e análise de bases relacionais.

- Cloud Functions: suporte e manutenção de funções serverless orientadas a eventos.

- Cloud Run: operação e monitoramento de aplicações containerizadas em ambiente serverless.

- Cloud Composer (Airflow): monitoramento, análise e suporte a DAGs, incluindo falhas e reprocessamentos.

- MongoDB: consulta, análise e suporte a bases NoSQL.

- Experiência com metodologias ágeis.


Requisitos Técnicos — Desejáveis:

- Experiência prévia com Open Finance.

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


About This Opportunity

As a Product Owner, you will work closely with both our Business Intelligence and Reporting Teams. In this position you will be accountable to manage data and reporting requirements to fulfill stakeholder or customer requests. You will also lead the roadmap and requirements analysis primarily for our financial systems.


The ideal candidate will have experience with Scrum/ Agile processes, Accounting/Financial Systems, SSRS, PowerBI, and Tableau. Knowledge of ETL and Oracle/Oracle EBS is a plus.


Professional English Language skills are required.


Position is CLT and fully remote (must reside in Brazil). Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for Internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!



Responsibilities

  • Work directly with Finance & Accounting leadership and BI teams on product backlog and coordinate with various technology teams across InComm to implement new solutions.
  • Build, manage and prioritize product backlog based on the overall strategy and business objectives for future product development.
  • Responsible for creating and/or managing following artifacts:

-Road Map

-Development Backlog

-User Stories and Sprint Tasks

-Supporting documents for user stories


  • Monitor and Review ServiceNow (SNOW) requests
  • Create product vision and roadmap which accomplishes the goal of the vision and convey that vision to the scrum team.
  • Ensure user stories are well defined and ready for development to begin.
  • Responsible for optimizing the value of the work done.
  • Accountable for each stage of the development process and the final product.
  • Ensure close collaboration with development team. Be available to address any questions team members have regarding requirements or implementation of a product feature.
  • Responsible for communicating with stakeholders across the board, including product managers, leadership, customers, and the development team to make sure their vision is aligned with business objectives.


Preferred Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experience with reporting and operations within Billing, Accounting, and Sales
  • Experience working in Agile/Technical environments
  • Skilled in and comfortable working alongside technical stakeholders, translating business needs into clear, actionable inputs for development or support teams.
  • Proficient in Agile/Scrum
  • Agile/Scrum Certification

title: Snowflake Data Engineer
description:
Overview

A US-based financial services organization is seeking an experienced Snowflake Data Engineer to support the ongoing development and optimization of its cloud data platform. This role will focus on building and maintaining scalable ETL pipelines, enforcing strong data governance practices, and preparing the enterprise data warehouse to leverage advanced capabilities such as Snowflake Cortex and Snowflake Intelligence.


This is a hands-on engineering role working closely with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to ensure high-quality, secure, and analytics-ready data.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines within Snowflake to support analytics and downstream use cases
  • Develop and maintain scalable data models to support reporting, BI, and advanced AI/ML workloads
  • Implement and enforce data governance best practices, including data quality, lineage, access controls, and compliance requirements
  • Prepare and structure data to enable future adoption of Snowflake Cortex and Snowflake Intelligence capabilities
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Monitor and improve performance, cost efficiency, and reliability of the Snowflake data warehouse
  • Support documentation and knowledge sharing across the data engineering function


Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience as a Data Engineer working with Snowflake in production environments
  • Proven experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines at scale
  • Solid understanding of data governance, data quality frameworks, and security best practices
  • Experience working in regulated or financial services environments is strongly preferred
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with cloud-based data warehouses


Preferred / Advantageous Skills

  • Experience with modern data tools such as:
  • dbt
  • Fivetran
  • Matillion
  • Apache Airflow
  • Experience collaborating with data science or AI teams

Ser responsável pelo desenvolvimento, evolução e sustentação das APIs internas e externas da DataCube, garantindo alta performance, segurança, escalabilidade e qualidade, além de liderar a equipe de desenvolvedores com foco em entrega, excelência técnica e gestão de pessoas.


Você vai ficar responsável por:

  • Projetar, desenvolver, manter e evoluir APIs internas e externas da plataforma;

  • Conduzir code reviews técnicos, assegurando qualidade, legibilidade e manutenibilidade;
  • Analisar gargalos de performance, latência e consumo de recursos, propondo soluções de otimização;
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, garantindo modelagem eficiente e integridade dos dados;
  • Implementar e manter mecanismos de observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing);
  • Participar da definição de roadmap técnico, evolução de arquitetura e decisões estruturais da plataforma;
  • Garantir aderência às boas práticas de segurança (OWASP, autenticação, controle de acesso, proteção de dados);
  • Documentar APIs, fluxos de integração e decisões arquiteturais;
  • Propor e implementar melhorias preventivas para reduzir riscos e débitos técnicos.

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento com PHP, Node.js, Java, Python.

  • Conhecimento avançado em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Experiência com arquiteturas escaláveis e distribuídas;
  • Forte conhecimento em Git e fluxo de trabalho colaborativo;
  • Experiência em análise de performance, profiling e otimização de sistemas;
  • Vivência com boas práticas de segurança de aplicações e APIs;
  • Capacidade de desenhar soluções técnicas complexas e sustentar decisões arquiteturais.


Competências Comportamentais:

  • Perfil analítico e crítico, com forte capacidade de diagnóstico e resolução de problemas;

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva para interagir com time, produto e stakeholders;
