title: AI Video Ad Creator +  Copywriter + Visual Asset Designer
description:
The opportunity


We’re building a high-output creative engine for paid ads-and we’re looking for a specialist who can write the words that sell and turn them into scroll-stopping short-form video ads using AI video tools, strong editing, and performance thinking.


This is not a “make pretty videos” role. This is concept → copy → creative → iterations → winners .

If you live at the intersection of genAI + storytelling + conversion copywriting , this role is for you.


You’ll create AI-driven video ads and visual assets for campaigns across TikTok, Instagram Reels/Stories, YouTube Shorts, Meta, and more. We optimize for ROAS, CTR, CVR, hook rate, hold rate, and retention -and the copywriting is a core lever in every asset we ship.


What you’ll do


You own the creative from message to motion-including the copywriting .

Copywriting + creative strategy

  • Write conversion-focused short-form scripts (15-45s) : hooks, problem framing, proof, offer, CTA.
  • Create multiple copy angles per concept (pain-based, benefit-based, curiosity, contrarian, founder POV, social proof, demo-driven).
  • Write and version hook lines, VO scripts, on-screen text, captions, headlines, end-card CTAs , and thumbnail copy.
  • Translate product benefits into clear, punchy, platform-native messaging (no fluff, no generic AI-sounding copy).
  • Apply direct-response frameworks (Problem → Agitation → Solution, Before/After, Myth-busting, Objection handling, etc.) with modern pacing.

Video production + asset creation

  • Produce short-form ad creatives designed for conversion (tight cuts, retention-first pacing, pattern interrupts).
  • Create AI-generated video sequences and combine them with real footage/UGC where needed.
  • Generate visual assets for ad variations: thumbnails, product scenes, backgrounds, overlays, cutdowns, motion graphics, end cards.
  • Build multiple versions of the same concept (different hooks, copy angles, pacing, captions, VO, formats).
  • Work from a brief and deliver fast iterations based on performance feedback.
  • Maintain brand consistency while still pushing creative boundaries.
  • Collaborate with growth/marketing to align creative with testing strategy and learnings.


Minimum requirements (non-negotiable)


To be considered, you must meet the requirements below and include proof in your application:

  • Resume must be written in English.
  • You must share examples of your AI video ad work with VO and Dialogue (not just AI visuals).
  • Copywriting is required: you must provide evidence you wrote/owned the scripts and ad copy for at least some of the work you share (scripts, hook lists, on-screen text, captions, or a short case study describing your role).
  • You must provide at least ONE of the following:
  • Evidence you produced creatives that generated strong ROAS / conversion lift (screenshots, case study, or summary metrics), OR
  • A video you produced that achieved 10,000+ views , OR
  • Proof you can create complex AI short-form ad videos (not basic slideshow edits-think narrative, scene continuity, ad pacing, multiple AI shots, strong compositing).
  • You have managed or been part of a social media account with 10,000+ followers .


What “qualified” looks like (skills we’re actively looking for)


You don’t just edit-you communicate and convert.

  • You understand what makes a video ad perform: thumb-stopping hooks, clear messaging, pattern interrupts, pacing, proof, offer structure, CTA clarity .
  • You can write direct-response copy that sounds human, specific, and brand-right-not generic “AI marketing” language.
  • You can create AI-driven visuals that look intentional and brand-ready (not uncanny or generic).
  • You can edit like a performance creator: tight cuts, retention-first pacing, captions, kinetic typography, sound design.
  • You have a repeatable workflow to deliver high volume with high quality (and keep assets organized).


Tools & workflows (use what you’re best at)


We’re tool-agnostic, but you should be highly capable with several of the following:

AI + creative

  • AI video generation (e.g., Runway, Pika, or comparable tools)
  • AI image generation (e.g., Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Voice & audio (AI voiceover tools, sound design, music selection, cleanup)

Editing + delivery

  • Editing & motion (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, etc.)
  • Creative versioning + organized file delivery (naming conventions, aspect ratios, exports)

Copywriting workflow (important)

  • You can work quickly in tools like Docs/Notion , and you know how to build:
  • Hook banks
  • Script variations
  • Angle matrices
  • Offer/CTA libraries
  • Caption + primary text variants aligned to the video


Deliverables & expectations


Typical output: 10 ad creatives per month (depending on campaign cycle), plus variations.

Format mastery: 9:16 primary , plus 1:1 and 16:9 cutdowns when needed.

You can deliver:

  • Final exports (platform-ready)
  • Project files when requested
  • Source assets used (AI outputs, overlays, audio references)

Copy deliverables (required):

  • Script + VO text (or structured script outline)
  • Hook variations (often 5-15 per concept)
  • On-screen text + caption plan (what appears when, and why)
  • End card copy + CTA variants
  • Optional: primary text/caption variants for Meta/TikTok where needed

Turnaround: fast iteration is key (often 24-72 hours per revision cycle , depending on scope).


How we evaluate success


  • Your creatives clearly map to an angle + message and drive action.
  • Iterations improve performance (hooks improve, retention improves, CTR/CVR improves).
  • Your output is consistent, organized, and easy to test at scale.
  • Your copy + editing work together (the words and visuals reinforce the same conversion story).

﻿

Compensation


Competitive and flexible based on experience and proof of performance.

Per project bases

If you’re a performance-minded AI creative who can write high-converting scripts and ship high-quality ads fast -and you have proof-apply with the items above.

title: Program Coordinator
description:
About Sofia Health

Sofia Health is a fast-growing wellness marketplace connecting clients with top health and wellness professionals. Through live classes, on-demand content, and 1:1 services, we’re making whole-person care more accessible and helping providers build thriving businesses.


Sofia Prime is our flagship wellness membership, offering 300+ live virtual classes every month focused on physical, mental, and emotional well-being—including yoga, meditation, fitness, tai chi, iRest, health coaching, and more.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Virtual Wellness Program Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of our Sofia Prime program. In this role, you’ll help with day-to-day operations, communicate with instructors, support clients, ensure a seamless experience for both sides of the platform, and help expand participation and engagement across the platform.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role ideal for someone passionate about wellness, tech-enabled solutions, and community building.


Responsibilities
  • Coordinate and publish weekly and monthly live class schedules
  • Communicate with wellness instructors to confirm availability, gather class details, and ensure timely updates
  • Provide basic support to clients and instructors (e.g., tech check-ins, live session support, FAQs)
  • Assist with monitoring class attendance and flagging any issues or trends
  • Help gather and organize feedback from members to improve class offerings
  • Collaborate with marketing and community teams to promote upcoming classes
  • Maintain accurate records and help ensure consistent program delivery


Requirements
  • 1–3 years of experience in wellness programming, admin coordination, virtual event management, or community support
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through
  • Comfortable using Zoom, Google Suite, and digital scheduling tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Enthusiastic, team-oriented, and passionate about wellness
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Bonus Points
  • Experience working at a health tech or wellness startup
  • Background in virtual wellness delivery or e-learning company
  • Familiarity with wellness programming tools and virtual event logistics

title: Engenheiro de Software Sênior (Python)
description:
A Ivy Group está com uma nova oportunidade para Engenheiro de Software Sênior (Python) atuar em um de nossos clientes do setor financeiro.

Buscamos um profissional com perfil executor, organizado e colaborativo, que tenha facilidade em entender regras de negócio e transformá-las em integrações e soluções técnicas.

O ambiente é dinâmico, com entregas semanais e desafios constantes. É importante ter boa comunicação, senso de responsabilidade e autonomia para lidar com mudanças de prioridade de forma madura e estruturada.


Sobre a oportunidade

Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) ou Cooperativa.

Modalidade: 100% Remota.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Python.
  • Domínio na criação e consumo de APIs RESTful.
  • Experiência em integração entre sistemas e manipulação de dados em formatos como JSON e CSV.
  • Conhecimento prático em bancos de dados relacionais e consultas SQL.
  • Capacidade de compreender estruturas de dados e trabalhar de forma alinhada ao time de engenharia de dados.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de versionamento (Git/GitHub) e gestão de tarefas (Jira).
  • Clareza e objetividade na comunicação técnica, especialmente em ambientes remotos.
  • Comprometimento com horários e rituais do time, garantindo constância e confiabilidade nas entregas.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência em processos de ingestão de dados ou integração com ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, DBT, ou similares).
  • Familiaridade com Snowflake ou outros bancos de dados em nuvem.
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes financeiros ou corporativos de alta criticidade.
  • Prática com testes unitários, boas práticas de código limpo e documentação técnica.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter APIs, integrações e rotinas backend que conectam sistemas internos e externos.
  • Implementar soluções para receber, tratar e disponibilizar dados de forma estruturada e segura.
  • Colaborar com o time de engenharia de dados, garantindo coerência na entrada e saída das informações que passam pelas integrações.
  • Traduzir demandas de produto e negócio em entregas técnicas claras e eficientes.
  • Participar ativamente dos planejamentos semanais e rituais técnicos, contribuindo com estimativas e direcionamentos.
  • Identificar gargalos e propor melhorias em processos e fluxos de integração.
  • Manter documentação atualizada de endpoints, parâmetros e dependências entre sistemas.
  • Atuar com autonomia e senso de dono, reportando avanços e eventuais bloqueios de forma proativa.


Perfil comportamental

  • Proatividade: busca soluções e esclarece dúvidas sem depender de microgestão.
  • Resiliência: mantém a qualidade sob pressão e diante de mudanças rápidas.
  • Autonomia: organiza o próprio trabalho e garante previsibilidade nas entregas.
  • Comunicação: expressa-se de forma clara, especialmente em interações remotas.
  • Colaboração: mantém boa relação com o time técnico e de produto, valorizando o fluxo coletivo de entrega.


Se você gosta de desafios e quer atuar em um ambiente de constante evolução tecnológica, queremos conhecer você!

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

O projeto envolve a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento de uma plataforma robusta, sustentada por uma infraestrutura moderna baseada em APIs. Faremos a integração com um parceiro fintech líder de mercado para lidar com a mecânica central de abertura de contas, financiamento e negociações (trading), permitindo que nossa equipe se concentre em construir uma experiência superior voltada ao cliente.

O sucesso exige mais do que apenas um código excelente. Você se juntará a uma equipe dinâmica e multidisciplinar de gerentes de produto, designers de UX/UI, estrategistas de negócios e especialistas em conformidade (compliance). Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração para navegar por regulamentações financeiras complexas, traduzir requisitos de negócios intrincados em soluções técnicas elegantes e resolver problemas desafiadores de integração com nossos parceiros externos. Esta função é ideal para um solucionador de problemas proativo, que prospera em um ambiente colaborativo e é apaixonado por construir produtos que tenham um impacto real no futuro financeiro das pessoas.


Requisitos

  • Inglês B2 ou superior.
  • Forte proficiência em Java, com foco em frameworks modernos — especialmente Spring Boot.
  • Conhecimento avançado em bancos de dados relacionais (ex: Oracle, PostgreSQL) e bancos de dados NoSQL (ex: CosmosDB, DynamoDB).
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços, incluindo padrões de comunicação como REST e gRPC.
  • Expertise em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (event-driven), utilizando ferramentas como RabbitMQ, Kafka e Amazon SQS.
  • Experiência na implantação de aplicações em ambientes de Nuvem (AWS ou Azure).
  • Proficiência em containers e orquestração, incluindo Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Implementação e automação de pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou ArgoCD.
  • Uso avançado de Git e estratégias colaborativas de ramificação (branching) (Gitflow, práticas de code review).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging, tais como Prometheus, Grafana e ELK Stack.
  • Implementação de estratégias de testes robustas (unitário, integração, ponta a ponta/E2E) utilizando JUnit, Mockito e Testcontainers.
  • Adoção de boas práticas em TDD/BDD e análise de cobertura de código.
  • Experiência de trabalho em equipes Ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência prática com sistemas de alto volume e alta escalabilidade.
  • Capacidade comprovada de contribuir para refatoração de código, otimização de desempenho e melhorias arquiteturais contínuas.
  • Compreensão de conceitos de sistemas distribuídos e sua aplicação prática.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de serviços complementares em Node.js.
  • Experiência com plataformas de investimento.
  • Experiência em ambiente financeiro.
  • Certificações em Nuvem (Cloud).


Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Senior Revenue Operations Manager


We are looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to own and continuously improve our Salesforce instance and broader sales tech stack.


You will maintain and evolve Salesforce, connect and manage key sales tools, and translate revenue data into dashboards and analyses that directly inform sales leadership and frontline reps.


This is a hands-on role for someone with 5-10 years of experience who can operate independently, prioritize intelligently, and partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.


Key Responsibilities:

-Salesforce Administration & Ownership

  • Own day-to-day administration of Salesforce (users, roles, profiles, permissions, objects, fields, validation rules, flows, reports, dashboards)
  • Maintain data quality through validation, deduplication, and ongoing hygiene processes
  • Implement and improve sales processes (lead management, opportunity stages, forecasting, pipeline management)
  • Manage releases, sandbox testing, and change management


-Sales Tech Stack & Integrations

  • Manage and maintain integrations between Salesforce and other GTM tools (e.g., HubSpot/Marketo, Outreach/Salesloft, Gong, ZoomInfo, CPQ, billing tools)
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and coordinate with vendors as needed
  • Evaluate new tools and support implementation and rollout


-Reporting, Dashboards & Insights

  • Build and maintain dashboards for sales leadership and reps (pipeline, forecast, activity, conversion rates, performance)
  • Produce recurring and ad hoc analyses to support forecasting, territory planning, quota setting, and performance reviews
  • Translate unstructured data into actionable business insights


-Cross-Functional Revenue Support

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success to align systems and data
  • Support planning cycles (forecasting, QBRs, capacity models)
  • Act as a trusted operational partner to sales leadership


Required Qualifications:

  • 5-10 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Salesforce Administration
  • Hands-on experience administering Salesforce in a production environment
  • Strong understanding of sales processes, funnels, and pipeline management
  • Experience managing or supporting sales tech tools and integrations
  • Proficiency with Salesforce reporting and dashboards
  • Ability to translate business questions into data and systems solutions


Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Administrator certification
  • Experience with tools like HubSpot, Marketo, Outreach, Salesloft, Gong, or similar
  • Experience with basic SQL or BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Exposure to SaaS metrics (ARR, MRR, churn, CAC, LTV)
  • Experience supporting forecasting and territory/quota planning


Why This Role

  • High impact on revenue execution and sales effectiveness
  • Broad exposure to systems, data, and go-to-market strategy

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Network Customer Success Engineer
description:

  • $21 USD per hour


Title: Customer Success Engineer

As a Customer Success Engineer within the LATAM SASE team, you will be part of a business-critical capability to enable our customers’ secure environments across the LATAM region. You act as their day-to-day technical contact, building relationships with them to ensure proper security integrations. This includes guidance for adoption, accelerated integrations with new cloud security products, and real-time support and strategy.

  • Assist customers in implementing SASE solutions and fully integrate these into their security and networking operations
  • Be the first line of defense in proactively addressing customer needs for technical assistance, and coordinating and prioritizing timely resolutions with engineering teams
  • Serve as a customer advocate in influencing product roadmap and improvements

  • Identify risks to the customer achieving their stated business goals and work with the account team to build a risk mitigation plan or escalate as needed
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of typical business challenges faced by customers and common objectives to appropriately map features and associated business benefits to address their needs
  • Be a Go-To customer expert on *** SASE security solutions and become a Subject Matter expert over time


Required Qualifications:

  • In-depth understanding of networking and security concepts and experience with multi-vendor networking devices such as routers, switches, firewalls, traffic generators, etc.
  • Understanding SASE architecture and value proposition
  • Enterprise-level designing/troubleshooting experience in Routing Protocols (BGP / OSPF / EIGRP)
  • Expertise with Remote Access VPN solutions, IPSEC, PKI & SSL, TCP/IP, Authentication Protocols (SAML, SSO, LDAP, RADIUS, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Linux (including BASH and Python scripting)

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software (Java)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

Atuar diretamente nos produtos da BU de Investimentos, apoiando o desenho técnico, decisões e evolução arquitetural dos sistemas;

● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;

● Definir e acompanhar rotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);

● Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa e representar a BU nos fóruns técnicos e estratégicos;

● Desenvolver e manter padrões arquiteturais específicos para a BU (design patterns, governança, observabilidade, práticas de versionamento, guidelines de APIs);

● Elaborar e gerenciar artefatos de decisão técnica (ADRs, RFCs, RFPs), documentando mudanças estruturais e justificativas;

● Apoiar squads na modelagem de domínios, integrações, definição de SLAs/SLIs/SLOs e desenho de fluxos críticos;

● Conduzir análises de capacidade, modelagem de volumetria, tuning de JVM e banco Oracle, e estratégias para cargas de alto volume;

● Avaliar e introduzir tecnologias que suportem o roadmap da BU: mensageria/eventos (Kafka), in-memory (Redis), observabilidade, caching, automação;

● Atuar em incidentes críticos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções estruturais para performance, estabilidade e resiliência;

● Propor e desenvolver PoCs e experimentos técnicos relacionados a modernização, cloud, dados e IA;

● Colaborar com Data & Analytics na definição de integrações, governança e estratégias de movimentação de dados;

● Influenciar boas práticas de engenharia (clean code, testes, CI/CD, padrões de API, segurança, resiliência);

● Trabalhar lado a lado com líderes técnicos, POs e engenharia para construir um backlog tecnicamente sustentável e evolutivo.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

● Profundo conhecimento em Java e Spring Boot (indispensável)

● Experiência com arquiteturas modernas: microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD e integração entre sistemas legacy e modernos

● Forte experiência prática em troubleshooting de escalabilidade, performance, tuning e concorrência


Bancos de Dados e Persistência

● Domínio de bancos relacionais, especialmente Oracle (query tuning, índices, particionamento, análise de planos)

● Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL e cache distribuído (Redis, MongoDB, Elastic)


Cloud, DevOps e Observabilidade

● Vivência com nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e arquitetura cloud-ready

● CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub Actions e Jenkins (principal))

● Observabilidade e resiliência: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, tracing distribuído, circuit breakers


Segurança e Compliance

● Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), mTLS

● Conhecimento de OWASP Top 10, boas práticas de API Security e criptografia

● Compreensão de requisitos regulatórios financeiros (LGPD, PCI, normas de mercado financeiro são diferencial)


Metodologias e Governança Técnica

● Vivência com Scrum/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, framework SAFe, SRE e práticas de engenharia moderna

● Governança de arquitetura, gestão de risco técnico e processos decisórios estruturados

● Documentação técnica: ADRs, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io


Mentalidade e Comportamentos

● Visão sistêmica, pensamento crítico e capacidade de simplificar arquiteturas complexas

● Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc

● Proatividade para identificar gargalos e conduzir melhorias de impacto

● Perfil colaborativo e orientado a influenciar engenharia com profundidade técnica

● Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes de missão crítica (core de investimentos)

● Fome por evolução tecnológica, dados, automação e inovação contínua


DIFERENCIAL:

● Conhecimento do mercado financeiro de investimentos.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (TypeScript)
description:
Radity is a global software engineering company delivering innovative digital solutions to clients around the world. Were passionate about building great technology and fostering a collaborative environment where people grow, take ownership, and make a real impact.


Were currently looking for a TypeScript Fullstack Engineer to join our remote-first development team. If you're someone who thrives in a fast-paced tech environment and enjoys working with modern tools like NestJS, Node.js, Next.js, and cloud services this is your chance to build great software with a passionate team.


Your Role

As a Fullstack Engineer at Radity, you'll work on complex and impactful applications using TypeScript across the stack. Were especially interested in candidates with strong backend skills in Node.js and NestJS.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain scalable full-stack web applications using TypeScript and Node.js and NestJS.
  • Build and maintain backend services using Fastify and modern API design principles.
  • Develop responsive and performant frontend applications using React, TanStack (Query/Table/Router), and Mantine.
  • Design, implement, and maintain data models and database interactions using Prisma ORM.
  • Integrate with internal and external REST APIs and third-party services.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers in a distributed, cross-functional team.
  • Ensure code quality through code reviews, testing, and best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the full stack in both development and production environments.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) B2+ level or higher.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and backend development with Node.js and NestJS.
  • Hands-on experience with Fastify or similar Node.js frameworks (Express, NestJS, etc.)
  • Solid experience with React and modern frontend tooling, including TanStack libraries.
  • Experience with Prisma ORM and relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred).
  • Good understanding of RESTful APIs, backend architecture, and data modeling.
  • A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and appreciation for clean, maintainable code.


What's In It for You

  • A remote-first role where you can work from anywhere.
  • Hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies and real-world challenges.
  • Supportive teammates who value quality, learning, and growth.
  • Opportunities to shape architecture and technical direction.
  • Flexible hours and a collaborative, open culture.
  • Support for certifications, learning resources, or professional development.

About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. title: Automation & Operations Specialist
description:
Job Title: Automation & Operations Specialist


Schedule : Full-time (40 hours/week); requires EST or PST working-hour overlap.


Location : Fully remote (LATAM-based candidates welcome).


About This Role:

Our client is a growing automation-focused company that builds custom operational workflows and systems. They work at the intersection of automation, no-code platforms, and AI-driven workflows to solve complex operational problems where no off-the-shelf solution exists.

We are looking for a hands-on Automation & Operations Manager to own the execution of day-to-day operational workflows. This is not a traditional project management role; it is an execution-focused position for a specialist who can build, maintain, and improve systems. You will work directly with the CEO to ensure system reliability and scalability.


Responsibilities:

  • Workflow Architecture: Build, maintain, and optimize automation workflows using Make.com and/or n8n, ensuring consistent execution across CRM processes and reporting.
  • System Integration: Design and implement custom solutions, managing API-based integrations and webhooks between various tools and platforms.
  • Troubleshooting & Reliability: Take ownership of existing automation libraries; diagnose failures, debug errors, and resolve issues efficiently to maintain high performance.
  • AI Implementation: Leverage AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, AI coding assistants) to accelerate workflow development and solve ambiguous technical problems.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Document workflows, maintain clear SOPs, and provide the CEO with regular updates on status, risks, and blockers.


Requirements:

  • 4–6 years of experience in automation, operations, or workflow-heavy roles.

  • Familiarity with JSON and basic scripting (JavaScript, Python).

description:

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Java Senior
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. ● Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações Java/Web, seguindo boas práticas e

padrões de arquitetura.

● Projetar e implementar camadas de persistência utilizando Hibernate e JPA.

● Criar e otimizar consultas e procedimentos em banco de dados Oracle.

● Escrever e manter testes unitários, de integração e performance.

● Participar ativamente das cerimônias e processos ágeis (planning, dailies,

processos.

produção.

● Experiência sólida com frameworks de persistência: Hibernate e JPA.

● Conhecimento avançado em banco de dados Oracle (modelagem, SQL, PL/SQL, performance tuning).

● Conhecimento em Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Docker e Kubernetes.

● Experiência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ).

● Vivência em ambientes de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.

● Experiência com práticas de DevOps e entrega contínua.

● Proatividade e autonomia para liderar técnicamente iniciativas.

● Mentalidade colaborativa e aberta para compartilhar conhecimento.

● Adaptabilidade para trabalhar em ambientes dinâmicos e interativos.

● Atualização constante sobre novas tecnologias e tendências do mercado.

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

Buscamos um profissional com perfil executor, organizado e colaborativo, que tenha facilidade em entender regras de negócio e transformá-las em integrações e soluções técnicas.

O ambiente é dinâmico, com entregas semanais e desafios constantes. É importante ter boa comunicação, senso de responsabilidade e autonomia para lidar com mudanças de prioridade de forma madura e estruturada.

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Python.

title: Sample Manager LIMS
description:
Technical Lead – Sample Manager LIMS

Brazil (Remote); preferred in Sao Paulo.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Lead – SampleManager to lead and deliver SampleManager

LIMS implementation and enhancement projects. This role is responsible for driving technical execution,

collaborating closely with clients and internal teams, and ensuring high-quality, compliant, and timely

delivery of solutions aligned with company standards and SOPs.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the technical team on SampleManager LIMS implementation and enhancement projects.

• Act as a technical front-facing resource with customers to understand enhancement

requirements and propose effective solutions.

• Facilitate requirement-gathering workshops and produce clear, detailed requirement

specification documents.

• Design, develop, configure, and implement enhancements and revisions to meet client needs.

• Deliver solutions according to agreed timelines, ensuring compliance with company standards,

SOPs, and quality guidelines.

• Provide technical guidance and support to internal team members and clients throughout the

project lifecycle.

• Evaluate client requirements and translate them into scalable, high-quality technical solutions.

• Contribute to the delivery of high-quality software through effective system design, peer code

reviews, unit testing, and best development practices.

• Participate across the full system lifecycle, including design, development, testing,

implementation, maintenance, and ongoing support.

• Collaborate effectively with multiple internal teams and multiple client stakeholders

simultaneously.

Technical Scope

• Develop and configure SampleManager workflows, including:

✓ Sample workflows

✓ Stock and instrument modules

✓ Instrument interfacing using Integration Manager

✓ Report Designer, Forms Designer, and Label Designer

✓ Sample Scheduler, Batch Management, Lot Management, and Plate Handling

✓ Stability, SQC, SM-IDI, PIMS, and Dashboards

Required Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in SampleManager implementation and support.

• Extensive hands-on experience developing and configuring solutions in SampleManager LIMS

• Strong background in systems analysis, design, development, quality assurance, and integration

methodologies.

• Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously with strong analytical and

problem-solving skills.

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a team, with minimal supervision in project

environments.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to balance and prioritize multiple concurrent projects.

• Excellent communication skills; English language proficiency is required. Spanish is nice to have

• Flexible, self-motivated, and proactive team player with a positive, delivery-focused attitude.

• Willingness and ability to learn and migrate to new technologies while adhering to priorities and

timelines.

• Clear understanding of individual and company goals, with a strong commitment to seeing work

through to completion.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Senior Revenue Operations Manager


We are looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to own and continuously improve our Salesforce instance and broader sales tech stack.


You will maintain and evolve Salesforce, connect and manage key sales tools, and translate revenue data into dashboards and analyses that directly inform sales leadership and frontline reps.


This is a hands-on role for someone with 5-10 years of experience who can operate independently, prioritize intelligently, and partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.


Key Responsibilities:

-Salesforce Administration & Ownership

  • Own day-to-day administration of Salesforce (users, roles, profiles, permissions, objects, fields, validation rules, flows, reports, dashboards)
  • Maintain data quality through validation, deduplication, and ongoing hygiene processes
  • Implement and improve sales processes (lead management, opportunity stages, forecasting, pipeline management)
  • Manage releases, sandbox testing, and change management


-Sales Tech Stack & Integrations

  • Manage and maintain integrations between Salesforce and other GTM tools (e.g., HubSpot/Marketo, Outreach/Salesloft, Gong, ZoomInfo, CPQ, billing tools)
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and coordinate with vendors as needed
  • Evaluate new tools and support implementation and rollout


-Reporting, Dashboards & Insights

  • Build and maintain dashboards for sales leadership and reps (pipeline, forecast, activity, conversion rates, performance)
  • Produce recurring and ad hoc analyses to support forecasting, territory planning, quota setting, and performance reviews
  • Translate unstructured data into actionable business insights


-Cross-Functional Revenue Support

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success to align systems and data
  • Support planning cycles (forecasting, QBRs, capacity models)
  • Act as a trusted operational partner to sales leadership


Required Qualifications:

  • 5-10 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Salesforce Administration
  • Hands-on experience administering Salesforce in a production environment
  • Strong understanding of sales processes, funnels, and pipeline management
  • Experience managing or supporting sales tech tools and integrations
  • Proficiency with Salesforce reporting and dashboards
  • Ability to translate business questions into data and systems solutions


Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Administrator certification
  • Experience with tools like HubSpot, Marketo, Outreach, Salesloft, Gong, or similar
  • Experience with basic SQL or BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Exposure to SaaS metrics (ARR, MRR, churn, CAC, LTV)
  • Experience supporting forecasting and territory/quota planning


Why This Role

  • High impact on revenue execution and sales effectiveness
  • Broad exposure to systems, data, and go-to-market strategy

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:

About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a Senior Product Designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Azure)
description:
About Us

Radity is a global software engineering company delivering innovative digital solutions to clients around the world. We are passionate about building great technology and fostering a collaborative environment where people grow, take ownership, and make a real impact.


We are currently looking for a DevOps Engineer experienced in Azure Cloud operations to join our remote-first engineering team. This position suits someone who thrives in building and maintaining large-scale infrastructure, ensuring performance and reliability, and communicating effectively with both technical and client teams.


Your Role

As a DevOps Engineer at Radity, you will manage, optimize, and automate Azure-based infrastructure. You will ensure the smooth operation of production systems, focusing on scalability, security, and monitoring. You will also work closely with developers and clients to provide technical clarity and maintain high service reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and maintain infrastructure in Azure Cloud, including AKS environments.
  • Automate provisioning and system management using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Oversee system monitoring, alerting, and performance tuning using Datadog and native Azure tools.
  • Manage GitHub Actions pipelines for continuous integration and delivery.
  • Implement best practices for cost optimization, networking, and cloud security.
  • Collaborate directly with clients to support operational needs and technical planning.
  • Participate in troubleshooting, incident response, and infrastructure improvements.
  • Review application configurations and read Python-based code when required to support deployments.


What We Are Looking For

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in DevOps or Cloud Operations.
  • Fluent English communication skills, with the ability to interact directly with clients.
  • Strong expertise in Azure Cloud, AKS, and infrastructure as code.
  • Familiarity with Python, GitHub Actions, and Datadog.
  • Strong understanding of networking, security, and performance optimization.
  • A proactive and reliable approach to problem solving and ownership.


What’s In It for You

  • A remote-first position with flexible working hours.
  • Hands-on experience with advanced Azure technologies and global-scale systems.
  • Collaboration with international teams and direct client interaction.
  • A supportive environment focused on growth, quality, and innovation.
  • Opportunities for professional certifications and technical development.

Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

Atuar diretamente nos produtos da BU de Investimentos, apoiando o desenho técnico, decisões e evolução arquitetural dos sistemas;

● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;

● Definir e acompanhar rotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);

● Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa e representar a BU nos fóruns técnicos e estratégicos;

● Desenvolver e manter padrões arquiteturais específicos para a BU (design patterns, governança, observabilidade, práticas de versionamento, guidelines de APIs);

● Elaborar e gerenciar artefatos de decisão técnica (ADRs, RFCs, RFPs), documentando mudanças estruturais e justificativas;

● Apoiar squads na modelagem de domínios, integrações, definição de SLAs/SLIs/SLOs e desenho de fluxos críticos;

● Conduzir análises de capacidade, modelagem de volumetria, tuning de JVM e banco Oracle, e estratégias para cargas de alto volume;

● Avaliar e introduzir tecnologias que suportem o roadmap da BU: mensageria/eventos (Kafka), in-memory (Redis), observabilidade, caching, automação;

● Atuar em incidentes críticos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções estruturais para performance, estabilidade e resiliência;

● Propor e desenvolver PoCs e experimentos técnicos relacionados a modernização, cloud, dados e IA;

● Colaborar com Data & Analytics na definição de integrações, governança e estratégias de movimentação de dados;

● Influenciar boas práticas de engenharia (clean code, testes, CI/CD, padrões de API, segurança, resiliência);

● Trabalhar lado a lado com líderes técnicos, POs e engenharia para construir um backlog tecnicamente sustentável e evolutivo.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

● Profundo conhecimento em Java e Spring Boot (indispensável)

● Experiência com arquiteturas modernas: microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD e integração entre sistemas legacy e modernos

● Forte experiência prática em troubleshooting de escalabilidade, performance, tuning e concorrência


Bancos de Dados e Persistência

● Domínio de bancos relacionais, especialmente Oracle (query tuning, índices, particionamento, análise de planos)

● Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL e cache distribuído (Redis, MongoDB, Elastic)


Cloud, DevOps e Observabilidade

● Vivência com nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e arquitetura cloud-ready

● CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub Actions e Jenkins (principal))

● Observabilidade e resiliência: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, tracing distribuído, circuit breakers


Segurança e Compliance

● Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), mTLS

● Conhecimento de OWASP Top 10, boas práticas de API Security e criptografia

● Compreensão de requisitos regulatórios financeiros (LGPD, PCI, normas de mercado financeiro são diferencial)


Metodologias e Governança Técnica

● Vivência com Scrum/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, framework SAFe, SRE e práticas de engenharia moderna

● Governança de arquitetura, gestão de risco técnico e processos decisórios estruturados

● Documentação técnica: ADRs, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io


Mentalidade e Comportamentos

● Visão sistêmica, pensamento crítico e capacidade de simplificar arquiteturas complexas

● Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc

● Proatividade para identificar gargalos e conduzir melhorias de impacto

● Perfil colaborativo e orientado a influenciar engenharia com profundidade técnica

● Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes de missão crítica (core de investimentos)

● Fome por evolução tecnológica, dados, automação e inovação contínua


DIFERENCIAL:

● Conhecimento do mercado financeiro de investimentos.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Client's growing team.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in web development with expertise in React , JavaScript, and Python . They must be comfortable working independently and will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining a high-performance web application.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain a robust, scalable web application, handling both front-end (JavaScript, React) and back-end (Python) responsibilities.
  • Take leadership of architecture and design efforts for new features within the application, ensuring alignment with best practices and company standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other engineers, to help design, iterate, & develop new features.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to coding standards and best practices.
  • Maintain and optimize existing codebase to maximize stability, performance and scalability.
  • Work with Python to develop backend services and APIs, and with JavaScript and React to enhance front-end processes and functionality.
  • Mentor and guide junior developers, providing technical leadership and helping them grow their skills.
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and consistency across the team.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of our development processes, tools, and methodologies.
  • Stay up to date with the latest industry trends, tools, and technologies, and recommend improvements to the technology stack.
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues across the full stack of the application.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience , with a strong focus on web development with Python .
  • Proficiency in React , JavaScript (ES5+), and modern web development practices.
  • Experience with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and tools such as Jira.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically about issues.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Proven experience leading projects and mentoring junior developers.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Python experience building and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Experience with databases such as MongoDB.
  • Understanding of front-end technologies, such as HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design.
  • Understanding of security best practices in web development.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with JavaScript development tools such as Storybook and Playwright.
  • Experience with API integrations with platforms like Workday or similar.
  • Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.

title: Arquiteto de integração
description:
Descrição da vaga e responsabilidades:


  • Responsável pela análise, design e manutenção do desenho de solução de integração para múltiplos projetos e sistemas. Irá avaliar a solução AS-IS e desenhar a solução ToBe, elaborar o documento de arquitetura técnica de Integração com a solução end to end das funcionalidades, definindo o datamapping e swagger das APIs, levando em consideração o TMFórum, OpenAPI e 4P, conforme definido na arquitetura de referência.
  • Realizar análise técnica de requisitos do projeto, mapeando os sistemas impactados e definindo a solução mais adequada de integração.
  • Garantir o desenvolvimento e a implantação das soluções de integração.
  • Efetuar o acompanhamento das entregas durante todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento das integrações.
  • Responsável por desenhar, especificar e implementar API's e Microserviços (novas e alterações) para projetos de transformação digital.
  • Desenvolver Backends com Spring / SpringBoot /Node Js
  • Auxiliar na avaliação e implementação de novas iniciativas tecnológicas e DevOps
  • Acompanhar, orientar e validar o desenvolvimento da equipe que será composta por outros desenvolvedores Junior, Pleno e Senior.
  • Realizar troubleshooting.
  • Acompanhar implantação em PRD e suportar início da operação
  • Realizar estimativas de desenvolvimento


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento utilizando conceitos/arquitetura em Microserviços.
  • Experiência em Padrões de segurança para arquitetura de microserviços como Token JWT, protocolo OAUTH e implementação de SSL2Way
  • Domínio no Desenvolvimento de API REST
  • Conhecimentos em arquitetura orientada a serviços (SOA).
  • Experiência em soluções utilizando Arquitetura distribuída, Microserviços e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos
  • Conhecimento em Automatização de testes;
  • Conhecimento em Linguagem Java e seus principais frameworks: Spring, SpringBoot, Maven, JUnit
  • Conhecimento em Soluções de consumo e publicação de mensagens em broker de eventos Kafka
  • Conhecimento em Conceitos de banco de dados relacional e não relacional
  • Conhecimento em Padrões e conceitos de exposição de API´s através do API Gateway
  • Experiência em Oracle SOA Suite 11g/12c (OSB, BPEL, BAM, Rules).
  • Experiência em Oracle Service Bus 11g/12c.
  • Experiência com Web Services (RESTful e SOAP).
  • Experiência em Enterprise Manager, DVN, XML, WSDL, WADL, XSD, JSON. xQuery, xPath, JAVA e PL/SQL.
  • Modelagem de entidades canônicas (SID);
  • Conhecimento de TMForum;
  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes com grande demanda por integrações.
  • Experiência com JIRA, Quality Center, Jenkins, SVN e GIT.
  • Softskill: criativo, gosta de resolver problemas, proativo, engenhoso.



Desejável Conhecimento em:

  • Plataforma de Container (Kubernetes)
  • Conhecimento de pipelines CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em DataPower.
  • Experiência em Telecom.

title: Senior NodeJS Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.


With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 5 years working with NodeJS;
  • Fluency in English (mandatory ).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

Sobre a vaga

O projeto envolve a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento de uma plataforma robusta, sustentada por uma infraestrutura moderna baseada em APIs. Faremos a integração com um parceiro fintech líder de mercado para lidar com a mecânica central de abertura de contas, financiamento e negociações (trading), permitindo que nossa equipe se concentre em construir uma experiência superior voltada ao cliente.

O sucesso exige mais do que apenas um código excelente. Você se juntará a uma equipe dinâmica e multidisciplinar de gerentes de produto, designers de UX/UI, estrategistas de negócios e especialistas em conformidade (compliance).   • Conhecimento avançado em bancos de dados relacionais (ex: Oracle, PostgreSQL) e bancos de dados NoSQL (ex: CosmosDB, DynamoDB).
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços, incluindo padrões de comunicação como REST e gRPC.
  • Expertise em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (event-driven), utilizando ferramentas como RabbitMQ, Kafka e Amazon SQS.
  • Experiência na implantação de aplicações em ambientes de Nuvem (AWS ou Azure).

  • Implementação e automação de pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou ArgoCD.

  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging, tais como Prometheus, Grafana e ELK Stack.
  • Implementação de estratégias de testes robustas (unitário, integração, ponta a ponta/E2E) utilizando JUnit, Mockito e Testcontainers.
  • Adoção de boas práticas em TDD/BDD e análise de cobertura de código.
  • Experiência de trabalho em equipes Ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência prática com sistemas de alto volume e alta escalabilidade.

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

A Jurassic Marketing é uma agência de Growth Marketing com atuação no Brasil e no exterior. Nosso core é eventos e festivais , ajudando produtores a venderem mais ingressos com estratégia, tráfego pago, funis de vendas, CRM e inteligência de dados .

  • Garantir que o lead chegue preparado e bem qualificado para as reuniões com nossos closers.

Seu objetivo é simples: encher o pipeline com qualidade e manter o funil andando com consistência.

Importante: boa parte da comunicação e condução do funil acontece via WhatsApp (contato e follow-up) e Google Meet (pré-calls e alinhamentos).

  • Realizar pré-calls de qualificação com leads inbound via Ligação no Whatsapp ou (diagnóstico + fit + próximos passos).

  • Abordar potenciais clientes via WhatsApp, LinkedIn e Instagram (social selling + prospecção).
  • Identificar dores, necessidades, momento do negócio e potencial de investimento dos leads.
  • Agendar reuniões qualificadas (SQLs ) com o time comercial.
  • Manter o CRM atualizado (histórico, notas, status e próximos passos).
  • Participar de reuniões rápidas de alinhamento com o time comercial.
  • Elaborar relatórios simples de atividades e resultados (cadência, taxa de resposta, pré-calls, SQLs, motivos de perda).


Requisitos
  • Experiência prévia em SDR/BDR, prospecção comercial ou vendas internas .

  • Conhecimento prático de social selling (WhatsApp, Instagram, LinkedIn).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas e foco em resultados (volume + qualidade).
  • Perfil comprometido, proativo e consistente


Diferenciais
  • Entender o mercado de eventos/festivais (lotes, sazonalidade, urgência, dores, problemas e dinâmica de produtores de eventos).
  • Experiência com marketing digital/performance (funil, lead, CPA, ROAS, etc.).
  • Vivência com CRM e automação comercial (GoHighLevel).
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado .


O que oferecemos
  • R$ 2.500 fixo + comissão variável atrativa (% sobre vendas + bônus por metas de reuniões qualificadas).
  • Remoto + flexibilidade com responsabilidade.
  • Folga no dia do aniversário
