  • Cursos online e materiais de capacitação disponibilizados pela empresa.
  • Ambiente que respira crescimento : metas claras, feedback rápido, cultura de performance e evolução constante.
  • Ferramentas estratégicas (CRM, IA, cadências e playbooks).
  • Possibilidade real de crescimento em uma agência com atuação internacional.

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Senior Revenue Operations Manager


We are looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to own and continuously improve our Salesforce instance and broader sales tech stack.


You will maintain and evolve Salesforce, connect and manage key sales tools, and translate revenue data into dashboards and analyses that directly inform sales leadership and frontline reps.


This is a hands-on role for someone with 5-10 years of experience who can operate independently, prioritize intelligently, and partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.


Key Responsibilities:

-Salesforce Administration & Ownership

  • Own day-to-day administration of Salesforce (users, roles, profiles, permissions, objects, fields, validation rules, flows, reports, dashboards)
  • Maintain data quality through validation, deduplication, and ongoing hygiene processes
  • Implement and improve sales processes (lead management, opportunity stages, forecasting, pipeline management)
  • Manage releases, sandbox testing, and change management


-Sales Tech Stack & Integrations

  • Manage and maintain integrations between Salesforce and other GTM tools (e.g., HubSpot/Marketo, Outreach/Salesloft, Gong, ZoomInfo, CPQ, billing tools)
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and coordinate with vendors as needed
  • Evaluate new tools and support implementation and rollout


-Reporting, Dashboards & Insights

  • Build and maintain dashboards for sales leadership and reps (pipeline, forecast, activity, conversion rates, performance)
  • Produce recurring and ad hoc analyses to support forecasting, territory planning, quota setting, and performance reviews
  • Translate unstructured data into actionable business insights


-Cross-Functional Revenue Support

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success to align systems and data
  • Support planning cycles (forecasting, QBRs, capacity models)
  • Act as a trusted operational partner to sales leadership


Required Qualifications:

  • 5-10 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Salesforce Administration
  • Hands-on experience administering Salesforce in a production environment
  • Strong understanding of sales processes, funnels, and pipeline management
  • Experience managing or supporting sales tech tools and integrations
  • Proficiency with Salesforce reporting and dashboards
  • Ability to translate business questions into data and systems solutions


Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Administrator certification
  • Experience with tools like HubSpot, Marketo, Outreach, Salesloft, Gong, or similar
  • Experience with basic SQL or BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Exposure to SaaS metrics (ARR, MRR, churn, CAC, LTV)
  • Experience supporting forecasting and territory/quota planning


Why This Role

  • High impact on revenue execution and sales effectiveness
  • Broad exposure to systems, data, and go-to-market strategy

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Azure)
description:
About Us

Radity is a global software engineering company delivering innovative digital solutions to clients around the world. We are passionate about building great technology and fostering a collaborative environment where people grow, take ownership, and make a real impact.


We are currently looking for a DevOps Engineer experienced in Azure Cloud operations to join our remote-first engineering team. This position suits someone who thrives in building and maintaining large-scale infrastructure, ensuring performance and reliability, and communicating effectively with both technical and client teams.


Your Role

As a DevOps Engineer at Radity, you will manage, optimize, and automate Azure-based infrastructure. You will ensure the smooth operation of production systems, focusing on scalability, security, and monitoring. You will also work closely with developers and clients to provide technical clarity and maintain high service reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and maintain infrastructure in Azure Cloud, including AKS environments.
  • Automate provisioning and system management using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Oversee system monitoring, alerting, and performance tuning using Datadog and native Azure tools.
  • Manage GitHub Actions pipelines for continuous integration and delivery.
  • Implement best practices for cost optimization, networking, and cloud security.
  • Collaborate directly with clients to support operational needs and technical planning.
  • Participate in troubleshooting, incident response, and infrastructure improvements.
  • Review application configurations and read Python-based code when required to support deployments.


What We Are Looking For

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in DevOps or Cloud Operations.
  • Fluent English communication skills, with the ability to interact directly with clients.
  • Strong expertise in Azure Cloud, AKS, and infrastructure as code.
  • Familiarity with Python, GitHub Actions, and Datadog.
  • Strong understanding of networking, security, and performance optimization.
  • A proactive and reliable approach to problem solving and ownership.


What’s In It for You

  • A remote-first position with flexible working hours.
  • Hands-on experience with advanced Azure technologies and global-scale systems.
  • Collaboration with international teams and direct client interaction.
  • A supportive environment focused on growth, quality, and innovation.
  • Opportunities for professional certifications and technical development.

description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

O projeto envolve a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento de uma plataforma robusta, sustentada por uma infraestrutura moderna baseada em APIs. Faremos a integração com um parceiro fintech líder de mercado para lidar com a mecânica central de abertura de contas, financiamento e negociações (trading), permitindo que nossa equipe se concentre em construir uma experiência superior voltada ao cliente.

O sucesso exige mais do que apenas um código excelente. Você se juntará a uma equipe dinâmica e multidisciplinar de gerentes de produto, designers de UX/UI, estrategistas de negócios e especialistas em conformidade (compliance). Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração para navegar por regulamentações financeiras complexas, traduzir requisitos de negócios intrincados em soluções técnicas elegantes e resolver problemas desafiadores de integração com nossos parceiros externos. Esta função é ideal para um solucionador de problemas proativo, que prospera em um ambiente colaborativo e é apaixonado por construir produtos que tenham um impacto real no futuro financeiro das pessoas.


Requisitos

  • Inglês B2 ou superior.
  • Forte proficiência em Java, com foco em frameworks modernos — especialmente Spring Boot.
  • Conhecimento avançado em bancos de dados relacionais (ex: Oracle, PostgreSQL) e bancos de dados NoSQL (ex: CosmosDB, DynamoDB).
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços, incluindo padrões de comunicação como REST e gRPC.
  • Expertise em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (event-driven), utilizando ferramentas como RabbitMQ, Kafka e Amazon SQS.
  • Experiência na implantação de aplicações em ambientes de Nuvem (AWS ou Azure).
  • Proficiência em containers e orquestração, incluindo Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Implementação e automação de pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou ArgoCD.
  • Uso avançado de Git e estratégias colaborativas de ramificação (branching) (Gitflow, práticas de code review).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging, tais como Prometheus, Grafana e ELK Stack.
  • Implementação de estratégias de testes robustas (unitário, integração, ponta a ponta/E2E) utilizando JUnit, Mockito e Testcontainers.
  • Adoção de boas práticas em TDD/BDD e análise de cobertura de código.
  • Experiência de trabalho em equipes Ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência prática com sistemas de alto volume e alta escalabilidade.
  • Capacidade comprovada de contribuir para refatoração de código, otimização de desempenho e melhorias arquiteturais contínuas.
  • Compreensão de conceitos de sistemas distribuídos e sua aplicação prática.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de serviços complementares em Node.js.
  • Experiência com plataformas de investimento.
  • Experiência em ambiente financeiro.
  • Certificações em Nuvem (Cloud).

title: Desenvolvedor FullStack (Node e React.js)
description:

A UDS é especialista em desenvolver softwares web e aplicativos personalizados com squads ágeis. Atende marcas como Calvin Klein, DHL, C&A, Madero, SKY, Correios, Yamaha e outras. Foi reconhecida entre as três melhores desenvolvedoras de aplicativos da América Latina e detém certificação PCI-DSS. Atividades:

Desenvolvimento Frontend:

• Criar e manter interfaces performáticas e responsivas com React.js e Next.js.

• Implementar componentes reutilizáveis utilizando React Hooks, Context API e Zustand/Redux.

• Garantir SEO e performance através de SSR, ISR e otimizações de carregamento.

• Criar APIs escaláveis utilizando Node.js com NestJS, Express ou Fastify.

• Construir arquitetura baseada em microservices e aplicações serverless (AWS Lambda, Firebase Functions).

About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: AI Video Ad Creator +  Copywriter + Visual Asset Designer
description:
The opportunity


We’re building a high-output creative engine for paid ads-and we’re looking for a specialist who can write the words that sell and turn them into scroll-stopping short-form video ads using AI video tools, strong editing, and performance thinking.


This is not a “make pretty videos” role. This is concept → copy → creative → iterations → winners .

If you live at the intersection of genAI + storytelling + conversion copywriting , this role is for you.


You’ll create AI-driven video ads and visual assets for campaigns across TikTok, Instagram Reels/Stories, YouTube Shorts, Meta, and more. We optimize for ROAS, CTR, CVR, hook rate, hold rate, and retention -and the copywriting is a core lever in every asset we ship.


What you’ll do


You own the creative from message to motion-including the copywriting .

Copywriting + creative strategy

  • Write conversion-focused short-form scripts (15-45s) : hooks, problem framing, proof, offer, CTA.
  • Create multiple copy angles per concept (pain-based, benefit-based, curiosity, contrarian, founder POV, social proof, demo-driven).
  • Write and version hook lines, VO scripts, on-screen text, captions, headlines, end-card CTAs , and thumbnail copy.
  • Translate product benefits into clear, punchy, platform-native messaging (no fluff, no generic AI-sounding copy).
  • Apply direct-response frameworks (Problem → Agitation → Solution, Before/After, Myth-busting, Objection handling, etc.) with modern pacing.

Video production + asset creation

  • Produce short-form ad creatives designed for conversion (tight cuts, retention-first pacing, pattern interrupts).
  • Create AI-generated video sequences and combine them with real footage/UGC where needed.
  • Generate visual assets for ad variations: thumbnails, product scenes, backgrounds, overlays, cutdowns, motion graphics, end cards.
  • Build multiple versions of the same concept (different hooks, copy angles, pacing, captions, VO, formats).
  • Work from a brief and deliver fast iterations based on performance feedback.
  • Maintain brand consistency while still pushing creative boundaries.
  • Collaborate with growth/marketing to align creative with testing strategy and learnings.


Minimum requirements (non-negotiable)


To be considered, you must meet the requirements below and include proof in your application:

  • Resume must be written in English.
  • You must share examples of your AI video ad work with VO and Dialogue (not just AI visuals).
  • Copywriting is required: you must provide evidence you wrote/owned the scripts and ad copy for at least some of the work you share (scripts, hook lists, on-screen text, captions, or a short case study describing your role).
  • You must provide at least ONE of the following:
  • Evidence you produced creatives that generated strong ROAS / conversion lift (screenshots, case study, or summary metrics), OR
  • A video you produced that achieved 10,000+ views , OR
  • Proof you can create complex AI short-form ad videos (not basic slideshow edits-think narrative, scene continuity, ad pacing, multiple AI shots, strong compositing).
  • You have managed or been part of a social media account with 10,000+ followers .


What “qualified” looks like (skills we’re actively looking for)


You don’t just edit-you communicate and convert.

  • You understand what makes a video ad perform: thumb-stopping hooks, clear messaging, pattern interrupts, pacing, proof, offer structure, CTA clarity .
  • You can write direct-response copy that sounds human, specific, and brand-right-not generic “AI marketing” language.
  • You can create AI-driven visuals that look intentional and brand-ready (not uncanny or generic).
  • You can edit like a performance creator: tight cuts, retention-first pacing, captions, kinetic typography, sound design.
  • You have a repeatable workflow to deliver high volume with high quality (and keep assets organized).


Tools & workflows (use what you’re best at)


We’re tool-agnostic, but you should be highly capable with several of the following:

AI + creative

  • AI video generation (e.g., Runway, Pika, or comparable tools)
  • AI image generation (e.g., Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Voice & audio (AI voiceover tools, sound design, music selection, cleanup)

Editing + delivery

  • Editing & motion (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, etc.)
  • Creative versioning + organized file delivery (naming conventions, aspect ratios, exports)

Copywriting workflow (important)

  • You can work quickly in tools like Docs/Notion , and you know how to build:
  • Hook banks
  • Script variations
  • Angle matrices
  • Offer/CTA libraries
  • Caption + primary text variants aligned to the video


Deliverables & expectations


Typical output: 10 ad creatives per month (depending on campaign cycle), plus variations.

Format mastery: 9:16 primary , plus 1:1 and 16:9 cutdowns when needed.

You can deliver:

  • Final exports (platform-ready)
  • Project files when requested
  • Source assets used (AI outputs, overlays, audio references)

Copy deliverables (required):

  • Script + VO text (or structured script outline)
  • Hook variations (often 5-15 per concept)
  • On-screen text + caption plan (what appears when, and why)
  • End card copy + CTA variants
  • Optional: primary text/caption variants for Meta/TikTok where needed

Turnaround: fast iteration is key (often 24-72 hours per revision cycle , depending on scope).


How we evaluate success


  • Your creatives clearly map to an angle + message and drive action.
  • Iterations improve performance (hooks improve, retention improves, CTR/CVR improves).
  • Your output is consistent, organized, and easy to test at scale.
  • Your copy + editing work together (the words and visuals reinforce the same conversion story).

﻿

Compensation


Competitive and flexible based on experience and proof of performance.

Per project bases

If you’re a performance-minded AI creative who can write high-converting scripts and ship high-quality ads fast -and you have proof-apply with the items above.

description:

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a Senior Product Designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Senior CISCO Engineer – Cisco Voice (CUCM, SIP)
description:
We are seeking a Senior Unified Communications Engineer with deep expertise in enterprise voice and telephony , who can lead and support the transition from Cisco on-premises UC environments to Microsoft Teams Phone and modern CCaaS platforms .


This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on design, migration, and Tier 3 support , working in a global enterprise environment across EMEA, US, and APAC.



Required


  • 7+ years of experience in Unified Communications / Enterprise Voice .

Strong hands-on experience with:

  • Microsoft Teams Phone
  • Cisco Voice (CUCM, SIP)
  • Solid understanding of telephony fundamentals and SIP-based architectures .
  • Experience supporting or implementing cloud-based telephony solutions .
  • Fluent English (spoken and written) – mandatory.


Nice to Have


  • Experience with Oracle SBC , Avaya, or similar platforms.
  • Exposure to Contact Center solutions (Cisco UCCE, Five9, NICE CXone).

Microsoft Teams Phone & Cloud Telephony

  • Integrate Teams Phone with SBCs and telecom providers .


Enterprise Voice & Cisco UC

  • Cisco Call Manager (CUCM)
  • SIP Trunking
  • Provide Tier 3 / engineering-level support for complex voice issues.


Contact Center & CCaaS


  • Support migrations of Contact Center platforms:
  • From Cisco UCCE / Five9
  • To NICE CXone CCaaS
  • Ensure stable SIP connectivity between telephony and CCaaS platforms.


Migration & Global Rollouts


  • Execute telephony migration plans with minimal service disruption.
  • Support global go-live events and post-migration stabilization.
  • Collaborate with regional engineering teams and vendors worldwide.



¡Join Us!


  • Work on enterprise-scale UC and telephony transformations .
  • Gain deep exposure to Teams Phone and CCaaS modernization .
  • Collaborate with global teams and leading technology partners.
  • Play a key role in high-visibility, business-critical projects

title: Programador(a) Python
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Programador(a) Python Pleno – Remoto


Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 28 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Programador(a) Python . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Graduação ou pós-graduação completa em Tecnologia da Informação ou correlatas, com carga mínima de 360 horas;
  • Experiência profissional comprovada como Desenvolvedor, Analista de Sistemas ou função equivalente;
  • Experiência sólida com Python 3.x em ambientes de produção;
  • Aplicar boas práticas de desenvolvimento, incluindo PEP8, clean code, testes automatizados com pytest, uso de typing e programação assíncrona com asyncio;
  • Gerenciar dependências utilizando pip ou poetry;
  • Desenvolver APIs RESTful utilizando FastAPI, Flask ou Django;
  • Aplicar padrões de documentação e governança de APIs com OpenAPI/Swagger, autenticação JWT ou OAuth2, versionamento, cache e práticas de segurança;
  • Integrar e consumir APIs de terceiros;
  • Utilizar PostgreSQL com domínio em SQL avançado, índices, migrations e otimização de consultas;
  • Atuar com bancos NoSQL como Redis ou MongoDB;
  • Realizar modelagem de dados e implementar operações CRUD;
  • Utilizar bibliotecas de acesso a banco de dados como SQLAlchemy, psycopg2 ou sqlite3;
  • Atuar em arquiteturas de microsserviços aplicando práticas de resiliência como retry, backoff e idempotência;
  • Utilizar soluções de mensageria como RabbitMQ ou Kafka para comunicação assíncrona e pipelines de dados;
  • Aplicar design patterns no desenvolvimento backend;
  • Utilizar contêineres Docker e pipelines de CI/CD com ferramentas como GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou Azure DevOps;
  • Realizar versionamento de código com Git, utilizando pull requests, code reviews e documentação técnica objetiva;
  • Realizar deploy e operação de aplicações em ambientes de nuvem AWS, Azure ou GCP, utilizando serviços gerenciados de computação, armazenamento, mensageria e controle de acesso;
  • Implementar observabilidade com logs estruturados, métricas e tracing distribuído utilizando Prometheus e OpenTelemetry;
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança considerando OWASP Top 10, gestão de segredos e análise de vulnerabilidades;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com times de Produto, QA e áreas correlatas;
  • Possuir inglês técnico para leitura e compreensão de documentação.


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Experiência prática em ambientes produtivos utilizando FastAPI, Pydantic e SQLAlchemy;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de orquestração e processamento assíncrono como Airflow ou Celery;
  • Conhecimento em estratégias avançadas de deploy como Blue/Green, Canary Releases e feature flags;
  • Experiência com Kafka Streams;
  • Vivência com arquiteturas e práticas de RAG e LLMOps, quando aplicável ao produto;
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de acesso a banco de dados como psycopg2, pyodbc, sqlite3 e cx_Oracle;
  • Vivência no uso de ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot e plataformas de automação ou geração de conteúdo, aplicadas à automação de tarefas, criação de relatórios, análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão, inovação contínua e melhoria da eficiência operacional e da qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter APIs e serviços backend utilizando Python;
  • Construir e manter integrações com APIs externas e sistemas internos;
  • Criar e sustentar pipelines de comunicação assíncrona por meio de mensageria, tarefas e workers;
  • Modelar dados, elaborar consultas otimizadas e garantir a integridade, desempenho e escalabilidade de bancos SQL e NoSQL;
  • Escrever testes automatizados, monitorar aplicações e promover melhorias contínuas em performance, segurança e confiabilidade;
  • Participar de code reviews, colaborar com times de Produto e QA e documentar soluções técnicas;
  • Contribuir para a evolução das práticas de CI/CD, observabilidade e padronização arquitetural do time.

title: Social Seller
description:
Descrição da vaga: SDR / Social Seller Pleno ou Sênior – Jurassic Marketing


Contrato: PJ

Remuneração: R$ 2.500 fixo + comissão variável atrativa (% sobre vendas + bônus por reuniões qualificadas )

Local: Remoto

Sobre a Jurassic Marketing

A Jurassic Marketing é uma agência de Growth Marketing com atuação no Brasil e no exterior. Nosso core é eventos e festivais , ajudando produtores a venderem mais ingressos com estratégia, tráfego pago, funis de vendas, CRM e inteligência de dados .

Também aplicamos a mesma lógica de crescimento em outros segmentos, com um diferencial forte: automação e IA aplicada ao comercial , especialmente no WhatsApp.


O Desafio

Você será responsável por gerar e qualificar oportunidades reais para o time de vendas.

No dia a dia, isso significa:

  • Qualificar leads inbound que chegam via WhatsApp e Instagram, conduzindo pré-calls estratégicas ;
  • Atuar como Social Seller , abordando potenciais clientes de forma inteligente (Instagram, WhatsApp, LinkedIn e base de interações);
  • Acompanhar as conversas do nosso SDR IA com os leads , entrar no timing certo e conduzir o lead para o próximo passo;
  • Garantir que o lead chegue preparado e bem qualificado para as reuniões com nossos closers.

Seu objetivo é simples: encher o pipeline com qualidade e manter o funil andando com consistência.

Importante: boa parte da comunicação e condução do funil acontece via WhatsApp (contato e follow-up) e Google Meet (pré-calls e alinhamentos).


Responsabilidades
  • Realizar pré-calls de qualificação com leads inbound via Ligação no Whatsapp ou (diagnóstico + fit + próximos passos).
  • Acompanhar e acelerar leads atendidos pela nossa IA no WhatsApp , assumindo quando necessário.
  • Abordar potenciais clientes via WhatsApp, LinkedIn e Instagram (social selling + prospecção).
  • Identificar dores, necessidades, momento do negócio e potencial de investimento dos leads.
  • Agendar reuniões qualificadas (SQLs ) com o time comercial.
  • Manter o CRM atualizado (histórico, notas, status e próximos passos).
  • Participar de reuniões rápidas de alinhamento com o time comercial.
  • Elaborar relatórios simples de atividades e resultados (cadência, taxa de resposta, pré-calls, SQLs, motivos de perda).


Requisitos
  • Experiência prévia em SDR/BDR, prospecção comercial ou vendas internas .
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita (objetividade, clareza e persuasão).
  • Organização e disciplina com follow-up e rotina de pipeline.
  • Conhecimento prático de social selling (WhatsApp, Instagram, LinkedIn).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas e foco em resultados (volume + qualidade).
  • Perfil comprometido, proativo e consistente


Diferenciais
  • Entender o mercado de eventos/festivais (lotes, sazonalidade, urgência, dores, problemas e dinâmica de produtores de eventos).
  • Experiência com marketing digital/performance (funil, lead, CPA, ROAS, etc.).
  • Vivência com CRM e automação comercial (GoHighLevel).
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado .


O que oferecemos
  • R$ 2.500 fixo + comissão variável atrativa (% sobre vendas + bônus por metas de reuniões qualificadas).
  • Remoto + flexibilidade com responsabilidade.
  • Folga no dia do aniversário

  • Cursos online e materiais de capacitação disponibilizados pela empresa.
  • Ambiente que respira crescimento : metas claras, feedback rápido, cultura de performance e evolução constante.

  • Possibilidade real de crescimento em uma agência com atuação internacional.

  • Graduação ou pós-graduação completa em Tecnologia da Informação ou correlatas, com carga mínima de 360 horas;
  • Experiência profissional comprovada como Desenvolvedor, Analista de Sistemas ou função equivalente;
  • Experiência sólida com Python 3.x em ambientes de produção;
  • Aplicar boas práticas de desenvolvimento, incluindo PEP8, clean code, testes automatizados com pytest, uso de typing e programação assíncrona com asyncio;
  • Gerenciar dependências utilizando pip ou poetry;
  • Desenvolver APIs RESTful utilizando FastAPI, Flask ou Django;
  • Aplicar padrões de documentação e governança de APIs com OpenAPI/Swagger, autenticação JWT ou OAuth2, versionamento, cache e práticas de segurança;
  • Integrar e consumir APIs de terceiros;
  • Utilizar PostgreSQL com domínio em SQL avançado, índices, migrations e otimização de consultas;
  • Atuar com bancos NoSQL como Redis ou MongoDB;
  • Realizar modelagem de dados e implementar operações CRUD;
  • Utilizar bibliotecas de acesso a banco de dados como SQLAlchemy, psycopg2 ou sqlite3;
  • Atuar em arquiteturas de microsserviços aplicando práticas de resiliência como retry, backoff e idempotência;
  • Utilizar soluções de mensageria como RabbitMQ ou Kafka para comunicação assíncrona e pipelines de dados;
  • Aplicar design patterns no desenvolvimento backend;
  • Utilizar contêineres Docker e pipelines de CI/CD com ferramentas como GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou Azure DevOps;
  • Realizar versionamento de código com Git, utilizando pull requests, code reviews e documentação técnica objetiva;
  • Realizar deploy e operação de aplicações em ambientes de nuvem AWS, Azure ou GCP, utilizando serviços gerenciados de computação, armazenamento, mensageria e controle de acesso;
  • Implementar observabilidade com logs estruturados, métricas e tracing distribuído utilizando Prometheus e OpenTelemetry;
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança considerando OWASP Top 10, gestão de segredos e análise de vulnerabilidades;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com times de Produto, QA e áreas correlatas;
  • Possuir inglês técnico para leitura e compreensão de documentação.


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Experiência prática em ambientes produtivos utilizando FastAPI, Pydantic e SQLAlchemy;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de orquestração e processamento assíncrono como Airflow ou Celery;
  • Conhecimento em estratégias avançadas de deploy como Blue/Green, Canary Releases e feature flags;
  • Experiência com Kafka Streams;
  • Vivência com arquiteturas e práticas de RAG e LLMOps, quando aplicável ao produto;
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de acesso a banco de dados como psycopg2, pyodbc, sqlite3 e cx_Oracle;
  • Vivência no uso de ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot e plataformas de automação ou geração de conteúdo, aplicadas à automação de tarefas, criação de relatórios, análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão, inovação contínua e melhoria da eficiência operacional e da qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter APIs e serviços backend utilizando Python;
  • Construir e manter integrações com APIs externas e sistemas internos;
  • Criar e sustentar pipelines de comunicação assíncrona por meio de mensageria, tarefas e workers;
  • Modelar dados, elaborar consultas otimizadas e garantir a integridade, desempenho e escalabilidade de bancos SQL e NoSQL;
  • Escrever testes automatizados, monitorar aplicações e promover melhorias contínuas em performance, segurança e confiabilidade;
  • Participar de code reviews, colaborar com times de Produto e QA e documentar soluções técnicas;
  • Contribuir para a evolução das práticas de CI/CD, observabilidade e padronização arquitetural do time.

title: AI Video Ad Creator +  Copywriter + Visual Asset Designer
description:
The opportunity


We’re building a high-output creative engine for paid ads-and we’re looking for a specialist who can write the words that sell and turn them into scroll-stopping short-form video ads using AI video tools, strong editing, and performance thinking.


This is not a “make pretty videos” role. This is concept → copy → creative → iterations → winners .

If you live at the intersection of genAI + storytelling + conversion copywriting , this role is for you.


You’ll create AI-driven video ads and visual assets for campaigns across TikTok, Instagram Reels/Stories, YouTube Shorts, Meta, and more. We optimize for ROAS, CTR, CVR, hook rate, hold rate, and retention -and the copywriting is a core lever in every asset we ship.


What you’ll do


You own the creative from message to motion-including the copywriting .

Copywriting + creative strategy

  • Write conversion-focused short-form scripts (15-45s) : hooks, problem framing, proof, offer, CTA.
  • Create multiple copy angles per concept (pain-based, benefit-based, curiosity, contrarian, founder POV, social proof, demo-driven).
  • Write and version hook lines, VO scripts, on-screen text, captions, headlines, end-card CTAs , and thumbnail copy.
  • Translate product benefits into clear, punchy, platform-native messaging (no fluff, no generic AI-sounding copy).
  • Apply direct-response frameworks (Problem → Agitation → Solution, Before/After, Myth-busting, Objection handling, etc.) with modern pacing.

Video production + asset creation

  • Produce short-form ad creatives designed for conversion (tight cuts, retention-first pacing, pattern interrupts).
  • Create AI-generated video sequences and combine them with real footage/UGC where needed.
  • Generate visual assets for ad variations: thumbnails, product scenes, backgrounds, overlays, cutdowns, motion graphics, end cards.
  • Build multiple versions of the same concept (different hooks, copy angles, pacing, captions, VO, formats).
  • Work from a brief and deliver fast iterations based on performance feedback.
  • Maintain brand consistency while still pushing creative boundaries.
  • Collaborate with growth/marketing to align creative with testing strategy and learnings.


Minimum requirements (non-negotiable)


To be considered, you must meet the requirements below and include proof in your application:

  • Resume must be written in English.
  • You must share examples of your AI video ad work with VO and Dialogue (not just AI visuals).
  • Copywriting is required: you must provide evidence you wrote/owned the scripts and ad copy for at least some of the work you share (scripts, hook lists, on-screen text, captions, or a short case study describing your role).
  • You must provide at least ONE of the following:
  • Evidence you produced creatives that generated strong ROAS / conversion lift (screenshots, case study, or summary metrics), OR
  • A video you produced that achieved 10,000+ views , OR
  • Proof you can create complex AI short-form ad videos (not basic slideshow edits-think narrative, scene continuity, ad pacing, multiple AI shots, strong compositing).
  • You have managed or been part of a social media account with 10,000+ followers .


What “qualified” looks like (skills we’re actively looking for)


You don’t just edit-you communicate and convert.

  • You understand what makes a video ad perform: thumb-stopping hooks, clear messaging, pattern interrupts, pacing, proof, offer structure, CTA clarity .
  • You can write direct-response copy that sounds human, specific, and brand-right-not generic “AI marketing” language.
  • You can create AI-driven visuals that look intentional and brand-ready (not uncanny or generic).
  • You can edit like a performance creator: tight cuts, retention-first pacing, captions, kinetic typography, sound design.
  • You have a repeatable workflow to deliver high volume with high quality (and keep assets organized).


Tools & workflows (use what you’re best at)


We’re tool-agnostic, but you should be highly capable with several of the following:

AI + creative

  • AI video generation (e.g., Runway, Pika, or comparable tools)
  • AI image generation (e.g., Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Voice & audio (AI voiceover tools, sound design, music selection, cleanup)

Editing + delivery

  • Editing & motion (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, etc.)
  • Creative versioning + organized file delivery (naming conventions, aspect ratios, exports)

Copywriting workflow (important)

  • You can work quickly in tools like Docs/Notion , and you know how to build:
  • Hook banks
  • Script variations
  • Angle matrices
  • Offer/CTA libraries
  • Caption + primary text variants aligned to the video


Deliverables & expectations


Typical output: 10 ad creatives per month (depending on campaign cycle), plus variations.

Format mastery: 9:16 primary , plus 1:1 and 16:9 cutdowns when needed.

You can deliver:

  • Final exports (platform-ready)
  • Project files when requested
  • Source assets used (AI outputs, overlays, audio references)

Copy deliverables (required):

  • Script + VO text (or structured script outline)
  • Hook variations (often 5-15 per concept)
  • On-screen text + caption plan (what appears when, and why)
  • End card copy + CTA variants
  • Optional: primary text/caption variants for Meta/TikTok where needed

Turnaround: fast iteration is key (often 24-72 hours per revision cycle , depending on scope).


How we evaluate success


  • Your creatives clearly map to an angle + message and drive action.
  • Iterations improve performance (hooks improve, retention improves, CTR/CVR improves).
  • Your output is consistent, organized, and easy to test at scale.
  • Your copy + editing work together (the words and visuals reinforce the same conversion story).

﻿

Compensation


Competitive and flexible based on experience and proof of performance.

Per project bases

If you’re a performance-minded AI creative who can write high-converting scripts and ship high-quality ads fast -and you have proof-apply with the items above.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

  • Experience integrating AI into automation workflows.
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., GoHighLevel) and lightweight app builders (e.g., Replit).


Payment: Long-term engagement (USD or local currency).

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Arquiteto de integração
description:
Descrição da vaga e responsabilidades:


  • Responsável pela análise, design e manutenção do desenho de solução de integração para múltiplos projetos e sistemas.   • Realizar análise técnica de requisitos do projeto, mapeando os sistemas impactados e definindo a solução mais adequada de integração.

  • Responsável por desenhar, especificar e implementar API's e Microserviços (novas e alterações) para projetos de transformação digital.
  • Desenvolver Backends com Spring / SpringBoot /Node Js
  • Auxiliar na avaliação e implementação de novas iniciativas tecnológicas e DevOps
  • Acompanhar, orientar e validar o desenvolvimento da equipe que será composta por outros desenvolvedores Junior, Pleno e Senior.
  • Realizar troubleshooting.
  • Acompanhar implantação em PRD e suportar início da operação
  • Realizar estimativas de desenvolvimento


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento utilizando conceitos/arquitetura em Microserviços.
  • Experiência em Padrões de segurança para arquitetura de microserviços como Token JWT, protocolo OAUTH e implementação de SSL2Way
  • Domínio no Desenvolvimento de API REST
  • Conhecimentos em arquitetura orientada a serviços (SOA).
  • Experiência em soluções utilizando Arquitetura distribuída, Microserviços e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos
  • Conhecimento em Automatização de testes;
  • Conhecimento em Linguagem Java e seus principais frameworks: Spring, SpringBoot, Maven, JUnit
  • Conhecimento em Soluções de consumo e publicação de mensagens em broker de eventos Kafka
  • Conhecimento em Conceitos de banco de dados relacional e não relacional
  • Conhecimento em Padrões e conceitos de exposição de API´s através do API Gateway
  • Experiência em Oracle SOA Suite 11g/12c (OSB, BPEL, BAM, Rules).
  • Experiência em Oracle Service Bus 11g/12c.
  • Experiência com Web Services (RESTful e SOAP).
  • Experiência em Enterprise Manager, DVN, XML, WSDL, WADL, XSD, JSON. xQuery, xPath, JAVA e PL/SQL.
  • Modelagem de entidades canônicas (SID);
  • Conhecimento de TMForum;
  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes com grande demanda por integrações.
  • Experiência com JIRA, Quality Center, Jenkins, SVN e GIT.
  • Softskill: criativo, gosta de resolver problemas, proativo, engenhoso.



Desejável Conhecimento em:

  • Plataforma de Container (Kubernetes)
  • Conhecimento de pipelines CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em DataPower.
  • Experiência em Telecom.

title: Program Coordinator
description:
About Sofia Health

Sofia Health is a fast-growing wellness marketplace connecting clients with top health and wellness professionals. Through live classes, on-demand content, and 1:1 services, we’re making whole-person care more accessible and helping providers build thriving businesses.


Sofia Prime is our flagship wellness membership, offering 300+ live virtual classes every month focused on physical, mental, and emotional well-being—including yoga, meditation, fitness, tai chi, iRest, health coaching, and more.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Virtual Wellness Program Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of our Sofia Prime program. In this role, you’ll help with day-to-day operations, communicate with instructors, support clients, ensure a seamless experience for both sides of the platform, and help expand participation and engagement across the platform.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role ideal for someone passionate about wellness, tech-enabled solutions, and community building.


Responsibilities
  • Coordinate and publish weekly and monthly live class schedules
  • Communicate with wellness instructors to confirm availability, gather class details, and ensure timely updates
  • Provide basic support to clients and instructors (e.g., tech check-ins, live session support, FAQs)
  • Assist with monitoring class attendance and flagging any issues or trends
  • Help gather and organize feedback from members to improve class offerings
  • Collaborate with marketing and community teams to promote upcoming classes
  • Maintain accurate records and help ensure consistent program delivery


Requirements
  • 1–3 years of experience in wellness programming, admin coordination, virtual event management, or community support
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through
  • Comfortable using Zoom, Google Suite, and digital scheduling tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Enthusiastic, team-oriented, and passionate about wellness
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Bonus Points
  • Experience working at a health tech or wellness startup
  • Background in virtual wellness delivery or e-learning company
  • Familiarity with wellness programming tools and virtual event logistics

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

title: Automation & Operations Specialist
description:
Job Title: Automation & Operations Specialist


Schedule : Full-time (40 hours/week); requires EST or PST working-hour overlap.


Location : Fully remote (LATAM-based candidates welcome).


About This Role:

Our client is a growing automation-focused company that builds custom operational workflows and systems. They work at the intersection of automation, no-code platforms, and AI-driven workflows to solve complex operational problems where no off-the-shelf solution exists.

We are looking for a hands-on Automation & Operations Manager to own the execution of day-to-day operational workflows. This is not a traditional project management role; it is an execution-focused position for a specialist who can build, maintain, and improve systems. You will work directly with the CEO to ensure system reliability and scalability.


Responsibilities:

  • Workflow Architecture: Build, maintain, and optimize automation workflows using Make.com and/or n8n, ensuring consistent execution across CRM processes and reporting.
  • System Integration: Design and implement custom solutions, managing API-based integrations and webhooks between various tools and platforms.
  • Troubleshooting & Reliability: Take ownership of existing automation libraries; diagnose failures, debug errors, and resolve issues efficiently to maintain high performance.
  • AI Implementation: Leverage AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, AI coding assistants) to accelerate workflow development and solve ambiguous technical problems.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Document workflows, maintain clear SOPs, and provide the CEO with regular updates on status, risks, and blockers.


Requirements:

  • 4–6 years of experience in automation, operations, or workflow-heavy roles.
  • Hands-on experience building complex workflows with Make.com and/or n8n .
  • Strong technical understanding of APIs, webhooks, and system integrations.
  • Proficiency with database tools like Airtable.
  • Ability to work independently to solve ambiguous technical problems without immediate supervision.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with JSON and basic scripting (JavaScript, Python).
  • Experience integrating AI into automation workflows.
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., GoHighLevel) and lightweight app builders (e.g., Replit).


Payment: Long-term engagement (USD or local currency).

title: AI Video Ad Creator +  Copywriter + Visual Asset Designer
description:
The opportunity


We’re building a high-output creative engine for paid ads-and we’re looking for a specialist who can write the words that sell and turn them into scroll-stopping short-form video ads using AI video tools, strong editing, and performance thinking.


This is not a “make pretty videos” role. This is concept → copy → creative → iterations → winners .

If you live at the intersection of genAI + storytelling + conversion copywriting , this role is for you.


You’ll create AI-driven video ads and visual assets for campaigns across TikTok, Instagram Reels/Stories, YouTube Shorts, Meta, and more. We optimize for ROAS, CTR, CVR, hook rate, hold rate, and retention -and the copywriting is a core lever in every asset we ship.


What you’ll do


You own the creative from message to motion-including the copywriting .

Copywriting + creative strategy

  • Write conversion-focused short-form scripts (15-45s) : hooks, problem framing, proof, offer, CTA.
  • Create multiple copy angles per concept (pain-based, benefit-based, curiosity, contrarian, founder POV, social proof, demo-driven).
  • Write and version hook lines, VO scripts, on-screen text, captions, headlines, end-card CTAs , and thumbnail copy.
  • Translate product benefits into clear, punchy, platform-native messaging (no fluff, no generic AI-sounding copy).
  • Apply direct-response frameworks (Problem → Agitation → Solution, Before/After, Myth-busting, Objection handling, etc.) with modern pacing.

Video production + asset creation

  • Produce short-form ad creatives designed for conversion (tight cuts, retention-first pacing, pattern interrupts).
  • Create AI-generated video sequences and combine them with real footage/UGC where needed.
  • Generate visual assets for ad variations: thumbnails, product scenes, backgrounds, overlays, cutdowns, motion graphics, end cards.
  • Build multiple versions of the same concept (different hooks, copy angles, pacing, captions, VO, formats).
  • Work from a brief and deliver fast iterations based on performance feedback.
  • Maintain brand consistency while still pushing creative boundaries.
  • Collaborate with growth/marketing to align creative with testing strategy and learnings.


Minimum requirements (non-negotiable)


To be considered, you must meet the requirements below and include proof in your application:

  • Resume must be written in English.
  • You must share examples of your AI video ad work with VO and Dialogue (not just AI visuals).
  • Copywriting is required: you must provide evidence you wrote/owned the scripts and ad copy for at least some of the work you share (scripts, hook lists, on-screen text, captions, or a short case study describing your role).
  • You must provide at least ONE of the following:
  • Evidence you produced creatives that generated strong ROAS / conversion lift (screenshots, case study, or summary metrics), OR
  • A video you produced that achieved 10,000+ views , OR
  • Proof you can create complex AI short-form ad videos (not basic slideshow edits-think narrative, scene continuity, ad pacing, multiple AI shots, strong compositing).
  • You have managed or been part of a social media account with 10,000+ followers .


What “qualified” looks like (skills we’re actively looking for)


You don’t just edit-you communicate and convert.

  • You understand what makes a video ad perform: thumb-stopping hooks, clear messaging, pattern interrupts, pacing, proof, offer structure, CTA clarity .
  • You can write direct-response copy that sounds human, specific, and brand-right-not generic “AI marketing” language.
  • You can create AI-driven visuals that look intentional and brand-ready (not uncanny or generic).
  • You can edit like a performance creator: tight cuts, retention-first pacing, captions, kinetic typography, sound design.
  • You have a repeatable workflow to deliver high volume with high quality (and keep assets organized).


Tools & workflows (use what you’re best at)


We’re tool-agnostic, but you should be highly capable with several of the following:

AI + creative

  • AI video generation (e.g., Runway, Pika, or comparable tools)
  • AI image generation (e.g., Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Voice & audio (AI voiceover tools, sound design, music selection, cleanup)

Editing + delivery

  • Editing & motion (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, etc.)
  • Creative versioning + organized file delivery (naming conventions, aspect ratios, exports)

Copywriting workflow (important)

  • You can work quickly in tools like Docs/Notion , and you know how to build:
  • Hook banks
  • Script variations
  • Angle matrices
  • Offer/CTA libraries
  • Caption + primary text variants aligned to the video


Deliverables & expectations


Typical output: 10 ad creatives per month (depending on campaign cycle), plus variations.

Format mastery: 9:16 primary , plus 1:1 and 16:9 cutdowns when needed.

You can deliver:

  • Final exports (platform-ready)
  • Project files when requested
  • Source assets used (AI outputs, overlays, audio references)

Copy deliverables (required):

  • Script + VO text (or structured script outline)
  • Hook variations (often 5-15 per concept)
  • On-screen text + caption plan (what appears when, and why)
  • End card copy + CTA variants
  • Optional: primary text/caption variants for Meta/TikTok where needed

Turnaround: fast iteration is key (often 24-72 hours per revision cycle , depending on scope).


How we evaluate success


  • Your creatives clearly map to an angle + message and drive action.
  • Iterations improve performance (hooks improve, retention improves, CTR/CVR improves).
  • Your output is consistent, organized, and easy to test at scale.
  • Your copy + editing work together (the words and visuals reinforce the same conversion story).

﻿

Compensation


Competitive and flexible based on experience and proof of performance.

Per project bases

If you’re a performance-minded AI creative who can write high-converting scripts and ship high-quality ads fast -and you have proof-apply with the items above.

Assistência Médica

title: Executivo (a) Comercial Externo
description:
Executivo(a) Comercial | Transforme o Setor de Energia com a Gente!

Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil

Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.

A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.

Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui

Sua Missão: Ser a Ponte Para um Futuro Energético Mais Justo

Como Executivo(a) Comercial, você será a cara da Liora para nossos clientes, sendo peça-chave para estruturar e escalar nossos canais de vendas. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.

Você será a peça-chave para:

  • Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
  • Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
  • Construir relações de confiança que duram.

Principais Responsabilidades:

️Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.

Desenvolver Parcerias Estratégicas: Mapear, negociar e ativar redes de parceiros que nos ajudem a multiplicar nosso alcance e impacto.

Realizar Vendas Consultivas: Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes para apresentar a solução da Liora de forma personalizada e irresistível.

Conduzir o Ciclo de Vendas Completo: Apresentar propostas de valor, negociar com clareza e fechar contratos que gerem valor real para os clientes e para a Liora.

Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente.

O que Buscamos em Você:

  • Perfil Hunter: Você tem energia, resiliência e paixão por abrir novas portas e prospectar clientes.
  • Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, direta e empática, criando conexões genuínas.
  • Foco no Cliente: Uma obsessão por entender, resolver problemas e encantar quem está do outro lado da linha.
  • Mentalidade de Dono(a): Autonomia para planejar, agilidade para executar e flexibilidade para ajustar a rota em busca dos melhores resultados.
  • Ambição Gigante: O desejo de não apenas bater metas, mas de construir a maior e mais confiável provedora de serviços de energia do Brasil

Nossa Proposta de Valor:

Remuneração Sem Teto: Salário fixo competitivo + comissionamento agressivo e sem limites. Aqui, seu resultado define seu ganho.

Plano de Saúde: Subsidiado pela empresa.

Seguro de Vida.

️Vale-Refeição/Alimentação.

Vale-Transporte ou Auxílio Deslocamento.

E aí, vamos transformar o futuro da energia juntos?

Se você se identificou com a nossa missão e acredita que tem o perfil para este desafio, queremos te conhecer!

description:
